# Question

Ermitteln Sie für jede übergeordnete Hauptkategorie (Kategorien mit parent_category_id IS NULL) den jeweiligen Artikel (product_name) mit der höchsten kumulierten Bestellmenge (quantity) über alle Bestellpositionen hinweg. Geben Sie den Namen der Hauptkategorie, den Produktnamen sowie die Gesamtmenge aus und ordnen Sie das Ergebnis aufsteigend nach dem Namen der Hauptkategorie.

# SQL

WITH ranked_products AS (
  SELECT
    pcat.category_name AS main_category_name,
    p.product_name,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY pcat.category_id
      ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity) DESC, p.product_name ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories pcat ON COALESCE(c.parent_category_id, c.category_id) = pcat.category_id
  WHERE pcat.parent_category_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY pcat.category_id, pcat.category_name, p.product_id, p.product_name
)
SELECT
  main_category_name,
  product_name,
  total_quantity
FROM ranked_products
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY main_category_name ASC

# Question

Für welche Produkte aus dem Sortiment (discontinued_on IS NULL) entspricht der Listenpreis (list_price) nicht dem höchsten jemals abgerechneten Brutto-Stückpreis (unit_price_gross) in nicht-stornierten Bestellungen? Gib product_id, product_name, list_price sowie den maximalen unit_price_gross als max_unit_price_gross aus, sortiert aufsteigend nach product_id.

# SQL

WITH product_max_prices AS (
  SELECT
    oi.product_id,
    MAX(oi.unit_price_gross) AS max_unit_price_gross
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.product_id
)
SELECT
  p.product_id,
  p.product_name,
  p.list_price,
  pm.max_unit_price_gross
FROM ecom_v1.products p
JOIN product_max_prices pm ON p.product_id = pm.product_id
WHERE p.discontinued_on IS NULL
  AND p.list_price != pm.max_unit_price_gross
ORDER BY p.product_id ASC

# Question

Welche Produkte (Name und SKU) erzielten bezogen auf den gesamten Datenbestand innerhalb ihrer jeweiligen Kategorie den höchsten Bruttowarenwert (Berechnung: Bestellposition-Menge multipliziert mit Brutto-Stückpreis abzüglich Positionsrabatt) über alle nicht stornierten Bestellungen? Bitte sortiere das Ergebnis aufsteigend nach Kategorie-ID und bei Gleichstand nach SKU.

# SQL

WITH product_sales AS (
  SELECT
    p.category_id,
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    p.sku,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) AS total_gross_sales
  FROM ecom_v1.products AS p
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items AS oi
    ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders AS o
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY
    p.category_id,
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    p.sku
),
ranked_products AS (
  SELECT
    category_id,
    product_name,
    sku,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY category_id
      ORDER BY total_gross_sales DESC
    ) AS rnk
  FROM product_sales
)
SELECT
  product_name,
  sku
FROM ranked_products
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY
  category_id ASC,
  sku ASC

# Question

Welche Produkte (mit SKU und Produktname) erzielten in ihrer jeweiligen Kategorie den höchsten gesamten Bruttoumsatz (Berechnung: quantity * unit_price_gross) über alle nicht stornierten Bestellungen? Gib für jedes dieser Produkte zusätzlich den errechneten Bruttoumsatz und den Kategorienamen aus.

WITH product_gross AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.sku,
    p.product_name,
    c.category_name,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross) AS total_gross_sales,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY p.category_id
      ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross) DESC
    ) AS ranking
  FROM ecom_v1.products p
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY p.product_id, p.sku, p.product_name, c.category_name, p.category_id
)
SELECT
  sku,
  product_name,
  category_name,
  total_gross_sales
FROM product_gross
WHERE ranking = 1
ORDER BY category_name ASC, total_gross_sales DESC, sku ASC

# Question

Welche drei Hauptkategorien erzielten über alle getätigten Käufe hinweg den höchsten Deckungsbeitrag? Gib den Namen der Hauptkategorie und den gesamten Deckungsbeitrag aus.

# SQL

WITH item_contributions AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(parent.category_name, cat.category_name) AS main_category_name,
    ((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate))
      - (oi.quantity * p.purchase_price)
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END AS contribution
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items AS oi
  INNER JOIN ecom_v1.orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  INNER JOIN ecom_v1.products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  INNER JOIN ecom_v1.categories AS cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories AS parent ON cat.parent_category_id = parent.category_id
  INNER JOIN ecom_v1.channels AS ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
)
SELECT
  main_category_name,
  SUM(contribution) AS total_contribution_margin
FROM item_contributions
GROUP BY main_category_name
ORDER BY total_contribution_margin DESC, main_category_name ASC
LIMIT 3;

# Question

Welche drei Kunden weisen den höchsten gesamten Deckungsbeitrag über alle ihre Bestellungen auf und wie hoch ist jeweils ihr kumulierter Deckungsbeitrag sowie ihr Rang (Platz 1 bis 3)?

# SQL

WITH customer_margins AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_number,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS total_contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_number
),
ranked_customers AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    customer_number,
    total_contribution_margin,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_contribution_margin DESC, customer_id ASC) AS rnk
  FROM customer_margins
)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  customer_number,
  total_contribution_margin,
  rnk
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY rnk ASC, customer_id ASC;

# Question

Welche drei Kunden mit dem Status als Wiederkäufer haben über ihren gesamten Bestellverlauf hinweg den höchsten aggregierten Deckungsbeitrag erzielt? Gib Kundennummer, Kundensegment sowie den gesamten Deckungsbeitrag aus.

# SQL

WITH repeat_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM ecom_v1.orders
  WHERE order_status != 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY customer_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', order_date)) >= 2
),
customer_cm AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS total_contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN repeat_customers rc ON o.customer_id = rc.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT
  c.customer_number,
  c.segment,
  cm.total_contribution_margin
FROM customer_cm cm
JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON cm.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY cm.total_contribution_margin DESC, c.customer_number ASC
LIMIT 3

# Question

Welche Kunden zählen gemäß unserer Definition als Wiederkäufer? Gib für diese Kunden die Kundennummer sowie die kumulierte Gesamtzahl ihrer nicht stornierten Bestellungen sortiert nach der Bestellanzahl absteigend und bei Gleichstand nach Kundennummer aufsteigend aus.

# SQL

WITH repeat_customers AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    COUNT(order_id) AS total_valid_orders
  FROM ecom_v1.orders
  WHERE order_status != 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY customer_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', order_date)) >= 2
)
SELECT
  c.customer_number,
  rc.total_valid_orders
FROM repeat_customers rc
JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON rc.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY rc.total_valid_orders DESC, c.customer_number ASC

# Question

Welche drei Kunden haben über alle nicht stornierten Bestellungen hinweg den höchsten gesamten Deckungsbeitrag erzielt? Gib Kundennummer, Kundensegment und den gesamten Deckungsbeitrag aus.

# SQL

WITH customer_margins AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_number,
    c.segment,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS total_contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_number, c.segment
),
ranked_customers AS (
  SELECT
    customer_number,
    segment,
    total_contribution_margin,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_contribution_margin DESC, customer_number ASC) AS rnk
  FROM customer_margins
)
SELECT
  customer_number,
  segment,
  total_contribution_margin
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY total_contribution_margin DESC, customer_number ASC

# Question

Welche Kunden zählen als Wiederkäufer und wie hoch ist deren kumulierter Netto-Umsatz über alle ihre bisherigen Bestellungen? Gib für jeden Wiederkäufer die Kundennummer sowie seinen Gesamt-Netto-Umsatz aus, absteigend sortiert nach dem Umsatz und bei Gleichstand aufsteigend nach der Kundennummer.

# SQL

WITH repeat_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM ecom_v1.orders
  WHERE order_status != 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY customer_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', order_date)) >= 2
)
SELECT
  c.customer_number,
  SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS gesamt_netto_umsatz
FROM repeat_customers rc
JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON rc.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON rc.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_number
ORDER BY gesamt_netto_umsatz DESC, c.customer_number ASC

# Question

Welche drei Hauptkategorien erzielten über alle getätigten Bestellungen hinweg den höchsten Deckungsbeitrag? Gib den Namen der jeweiligen Hauptkategorie sowie den gesamten Deckungsbeitrag an.

# SQL

WITH RECURSIVE cat_tree AS (
  SELECT
    category_id,
    category_name,
    category_id AS root_category_id,
    category_name AS root_category_name
  FROM ecom_v1.categories
  WHERE parent_category_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    c.category_id,
    c.category_name,
    ct.root_category_id,
    ct.root_category_name
  FROM ecom_v1.categories c
  JOIN cat_tree ct ON c.parent_category_id = ct.category_id
),
item_margins AS (
  SELECT
    ct.root_category_name,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END AS item_deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN cat_tree ct ON ct.category_id = p.category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
)
SELECT
  root_category_name AS main_category_name,
  SUM(item_deckungsbeitrag) AS total_deckungsbeitrag
FROM item_margins
GROUP BY root_category_name
ORDER BY total_deckungsbeitrag DESC, main_category_name ASC
LIMIT 3;

# Question

Berechne für das Kalenderjahr 2025 je Monat die Summe der bestellten Artikelmengen (quantity) sowie die kumulierte Gesamtsumme der Artikelmengen seit Jahresbeginn bis zum jeweiligen Monat. Welche Monate übersteigen dabei einen monatlichen Wert von 3.000 Stück?

# SQL

WITH monthly_quantities AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_date) AS order_month,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity
  FROM ecom_v1.orders AS o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items AS oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY order_month
),
cumulative_quantities AS (
  SELECT
    order_month,
    total_quantity,
    SUM(total_quantity) OVER (
      ORDER BY order_month
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS running_total_quantity
  FROM monthly_quantities
)
SELECT
  order_month,
  total_quantity,
  running_total_quantity
FROM cumulative_quantities
WHERE total_quantity > 3000
ORDER BY order_month ASC

# Question

Welche Kunden (Kundennummer und E-Mail bzw. Segment) haben im Jahr 2025 in beiden Jahreshälften (H1: 2025-01-01 bis 2025-06-30 und H2: 2025-07-01 bis 2025-12-31) jeweils mindestens eine Bestellung aufgegeben? Gib für diese Kunden die Kundennummer, das Kundensegment sowie die Gesamtanzahl ihrer Bestellungen im gesamten Jahr 2025 an, absteigend sortiert nach der Gesamtbestellanzahl und bei Gleichstand aufsteigend nach Kundennummer.

# SQL

WITH orders_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    order_id,
    order_date,
    COUNT(order_id) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) AS total_orders_2025
  FROM ecom_v1.orders
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
),
h1_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
  FROM orders_2025
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
),
h2_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
  FROM orders_2025
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
),
both_halves AS (
  SELECT customer_id FROM h1_customers
  INTERSECT DISTINCT
  SELECT customer_id FROM h2_customers
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  c.customer_number,
  c.segment,
  o.total_orders_2025
FROM both_halves bh
JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON bh.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN orders_2025 o ON bh.customer_id = o.customer_id
ORDER BY total_orders_2025 DESC, c.customer_number ASC

Berechne für jeden Monat im Kalenderjahr 2025 die monatliche Summe der tatsächlich berechneten Bruttowerte (Menge mal Bruttoeinzelpreis abzüglich Positionsrabatt) über alle Bestellpositionen hinweg sowie die kumulierte Jahressumme dieses Wertes bis zum jeweiligen Monat. WITH monthly_amounts AS (
  SELECT
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month_str,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) AS monthly_gross_total
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'

  month_str,
  monthly_gross_total,
  SUM(monthly_gross_total) OVER (ORDER BY month_str ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_gross_total
FROM monthly_amounts
ORDER BY month_str ASC

# Question

Welche Kunden (Kundennummer und Kundensegment) erzielten im Kalenderjahr 2025 die höchsten addierten Bruttobestellwerte (Menge mal Brutto-Stückpreis abzüglich Rabatt)? Gib für alle Kunden mit mindestens einer nicht stornierten Bestellung im Jahr 2025 zusätzlich ihren Rang nach diesem Gesamtbruttowert sowie die Differenz zum Gesamtbruttowert des unmittelbar vor ihnen platzierten Kunden aus, beschränkt auf die Top 10.

# SQL

WITH customer_spend AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_number,
    c.segment,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) AS total_gross_spend
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY
    c.customer_number,
    c.segment
),
ranked_spend AS (
  SELECT
    customer_number,
    segment,
    total_gross_spend,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_gross_spend DESC) AS spend_rank,
    LAG(total_gross_spend) OVER (ORDER BY total_gross_spend DESC) - total_gross_spend AS diff_to_predecessor
  FROM customer_spend
)
SELECT
  customer_number,
  segment,
  total_gross_spend,
  spend_rank,
  diff_to_predecessor
FROM ranked_spend
ORDER BY spend_rank ASC, customer_number ASC
LIMIT 10

# Question

Berechne für jeden Monat im Kalenderjahr 2025 die Summe der Bestellpositionen vor Rabatt und Steuern (Menge multipliziert mit Bruttoeinzelpreis) sowie die kumulierte Jahressumme dieses Wertes bis zum jeweiligen Monat und die prozentuale Veränderung des Monatswerts im Vergleich zum Vormonat.

# SQL

WITH monthly_gross AS (
  SELECT
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS monat,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross) AS monatswert
  FROM ecom_v1.orders AS o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items AS oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY monat
)
SELECT
  monat,
  monatswert,
  SUM(monatswert) OVER (
    ORDER BY monat
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS kumulierter_jahreswert,
  ROUND(
    (monatswert - LAG(monatswert) OVER (ORDER BY monat)) * 100.0
    / LAG(monatswert) OVER (ORDER BY monat),
    2
  ) AS wachstum_vormonat_prozent
FROM monthly_gross
ORDER BY monat ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz für die drei umsatzstärksten Vertriebskanäle im Kalenderjahr 2025, und wie hoch war deren jeweiliger prozentualer Anteil am gesamten Netto-Umsatz aller Kanäle in diesem Jahr?

# SQL

WITH channel_net_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_id,
    ch.channel_name,
    SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.channels ch
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name
),
ranked_channels AS (
  SELECT
    channel_id,
    channel_name,
    net_revenue,
    net_revenue / SUM(net_revenue) OVER () * 100 AS revenue_share_pct,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, channel_id ASC) AS rnk
  FROM channel_net_revenue
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  net_revenue,
  revenue_share_pct
FROM ranked_channels
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, channel_id ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag für die einzelnen Monate des Jahres 2025, und wie hoch war die absolute Veränderung dieses Deckungsbeitrags im Vergleich zum jeweiligen Vormonat?

# SQL

WITH monthly_cm AS (
  SELECT
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS year_month,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY year_month
)
SELECT
  year_month,
  deckungsbeitrag,
  deckungsbeitrag - LAG(deckungsbeitrag) OVER (ORDER BY year_month) AS mom_veraenderung
FROM monthly_cm
ORDER BY year_month ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag für die Vertriebskanäle im Kalenderjahr 2025, welcher Rang ergibt sich daraus je Kanal und wie hoch ist die Differenz des Deckungsbeitrags zum jeweils nächstbesseren Kanal?

# SQL

WITH channel_margins AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_id,
    ch.channel_name,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - (oi.quantity * p.purchase_price)
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.channels ch
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name
)
SELECT
  channel_id,
  channel_name,
  deckungsbeitrag,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY deckungsbeitrag DESC) AS rang,
  LAG(deckungsbeitrag) OVER (ORDER BY deckungsbeitrag DESC) - deckungsbeitrag AS differenz_zum_vorherigen
FROM channel_margins
ORDER BY rang ASC, channel_id ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz pro Kalendermonat im Jahr 2025, und wie stellte sich dieser im Vergleich zum Vormonat (Differenz zum Vormonat) dar?

# SQL

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    d.year,
    d.month,
    ROUND(SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)), 2) AS netto_umsatz
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.dim_date d ON o.order_date = d.date_key
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND d.year = 2025
  GROUP BY d.year, d.month
)
SELECT
  year,
  month,
  netto_umsatz,
  ROUND(netto_umsatz - LAG(netto_umsatz) OVER (ORDER BY year, month), 2) AS diff_vormonat
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY year, month

FROM monthly_revenue

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Vertriebskanal in den Kalenderjahren 2024 und 2025, und welcher Kanal belegte in dem jeweiligen Jahr nach Deckungsbeitrag welchen Rang?

# SQL

WITH channel_yearly_margin AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS jahr,
    ch.channel_name,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY jahr, ch.channel_name
)
SELECT
  jahr,
  channel_name,
  deckungsbeitrag,
  DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY jahr ORDER BY deckungsbeitrag DESC) AS rang
FROM channel_yearly_margin
ORDER BY jahr ASC, rang ASC, channel_name ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz in den einzelnen Kalenderquartalen des Jahres 2025, und wie hoch war die absolute Veränderung sowie das prozentuale Wachstum des Netto-Umsatzes im Vergleich zum jeweils vorhergehenden Quartal?

# SQL

WITH quarterly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    d.year,
    d.quarter,
    SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.dim_date d
    ON o.order_date = d.date_key
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND d.year = 2025
  GROUP BY
    d.year,
    d.quarter
)
SELECT
  year,
  quarter,
  ROUND(net_revenue, 2) AS net_revenue,
  ROUND(net_revenue - LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY quarter), 2) AS absolute_change,
  ROUND((net_revenue - LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY quarter)) / LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY quarter) * 100, 2) AS percentage_growth
FROM quarterly_revenue
ORDER BY
  quarter ASC

WITH channel_margin AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_id,
    ch.channel_name,

      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate

  FROM ecom_v1.orders o

# Question

Wie hoch ist die Summe aus quantity multipliziert mit unit_price_gross abzüglich discount_amount je Vertriebskanal in den letzten 30 Tagen bis einschließlich Stichtag (2026-06-30), welcher Rang (DENSE_RANK absteigend nach diesem Betrag) ergibt sich daraus, und welcher Kanal hatte den höchsten Betrag in dieser Periode verglichen mit dem höchsten Betrag im unmittelbar davorliegenden 30-Tage-Fenster?

# SQL

WITH period_totals AS (
  SELECT
    'aktuelle_30_tage' AS zeitraum,
    ch.channel_name,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) AS summe_betrag
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 29 DAY) AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'vorherige_30_tage' AS zeitraum,
    ch.channel_name,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) AS summe_betrag
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 59 DAY) AND DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name
),
ranked_periods AS (
  SELECT
    zeitraum,
    channel_name,
    summe_betrag,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY zeitraum ORDER BY summe_betrag DESC) AS rang
  FROM period_totals
)
SELECT
  zeitraum,
  channel_name,
  summe_betrag,
  rang
FROM ranked_periods
WHERE rang = 1 OR zeitraum = 'aktuelle_30_tage'
ORDER BY zeitraum, rang, channel_name

# Question

Welche Kunden hatten in den letzten 30 Tagen vor dem Stichtag 2026-06-30 mindestens zwei Bestellungen aufgegeben, und wie lauten für diese Kunden jeweils ihre Kundennummer, das Bestelldatum ihrer chronologisch ersten und letzten Bestellung in diesem Zeitraum sowie die Gesamtzahl ihrer Bestellungen in diesem Zeitraum? Sortieren Sie das Ergebnis absteigend nach der Anzahl der Bestellungen und bei Gleichstand aufsteigend nach der Kundennummer.

# SQL

WITH customer_orders_window AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    c.customer_number,
    o.order_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_date ASC, o.order_id ASC) AS rn_first,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.order_id DESC) AS rn_last,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id) AS total_orders
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND DATE '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
  first_o.customer_number,
  first_o.order_date AS first_order_date,
  last_o.order_date AS last_order_date,
  first_o.total_orders
FROM customer_orders_window first_o
JOIN customer_orders_window last_o
  ON first_o.customer_id = last_o.customer_id
WHERE first_o.rn_first = 1
  AND last_o.rn_last = 1
  AND first_o.total_orders >= 2
ORDER BY
  total_orders DESC,
  customer_number ASC

# Question

Welche Kunden haben in den letzten 30 Tagen vor dem Stichtag 30.06.2026 mehr als eine Bestellung aufgegeben? Gib für diese Kunden die Kundennummer sowie die Bestellanzahl in diesem Zeitraum und ihren Rang basierend auf der Bestellanzahl (absteigend, bei Gleichstand nach Kundennummer aufsteigend) an.

# SQL

WITH customer_orders AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_number,
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS anzahl_bestellungen
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_number
  HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 1
)
SELECT
  customer_number,
  anzahl_bestellungen,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY anzahl_bestellungen DESC, customer_number ASC) AS rang
FROM customer_orders
ORDER BY rang ASC;

# Question

Ermittle für aktive Kunden die Top 3 Kunden mit dem höchsten Deckungsbeitrag in den letzten 90 Tagen bis einschließlich zum Stichtag. Gib Kundennummer, den gesamten Deckungsbeitrag sowie den Rang (ohne Lücken bei Punktegleichstand) aus, sortiert nach Rang aufsteigend und bei Gleichstand nach Kundennummer aufsteigend.

# SQL

WITH active_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.customer_number
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-06-30'
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
),
order_margins AS (
  SELECT
    ac.customer_number,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS total_deckungsbeitrag
  FROM active_customers ac
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.customer_id = ac.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY ac.customer_number
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    customer_number,
    total_deckungsbeitrag,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_deckungsbeitrag DESC) AS rnk
  FROM order_margins
)
SELECT
  customer_number,
  total_deckungsbeitrag,
  rnk
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY rnk ASC, customer_number ASC

# Question

Ermittle für jeden Kunden, der in den letzten 90 Tagen bis zum Stichtag mindestens eine nicht-stornierte Bestellung getätigt hat, die Kundennummer und das jeweilige Bestelldatum seiner letzten beiden nicht-stornierten Bestellungen in diesem Zeitraum. Gib dazu den Netto-Umsatz dieser jeweiligen Bestellung an und sortiere das Ergebnis aufsteigend nach Kundennummer und absteigend nach Bestelldatum.

# SQL

WITH recent_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.order_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.order_id DESC) AS rn
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-06-30'
),
order_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    oi.order_id,
    SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS order_net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  GROUP BY oi.order_id
)
SELECT
  c.customer_number,
  ro.order_date,
  rev.order_net_revenue AS netto_umsatz
FROM recent_orders ro
JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON ro.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN order_revenue rev ON ro.order_id = rev.order_id
WHERE ro.rn <= 2
ORDER BY c.customer_number ASC, ro.order_date DESC, ro.order_id DESC

# Question

Ermittle für die letzten 30 Tage bis zum Stichtag den täglichen Netto-Umsatz sowie den gleitenden 7-Tage-Durchschnitt dieses Netto-Umsatzes (inklusive des jeweiligen Tages). Gib das Bestelldatum, den Tagesumsatz gerundet auf 2 Dezimalstellen und den 7-Tage-Durchschnitt gerundet auf 2 Dezimalstellen aus, chronologisch sortiert nach Bestelldatum.

# SQL

WITH daily_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_date,
    SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS daily_net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 36 DAY) AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY o.order_date
),
moving_calc AS (
  SELECT
    order_date,
    daily_net_revenue,
    AVG(daily_net_revenue) OVER (
      ORDER BY order_date
      ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS moving_avg_7d
  FROM daily_revenue
)
SELECT
  order_date,
  ROUND(daily_net_revenue, 2) AS daily_net_revenue,
  ROUND(moving_avg_7d, 2) AS moving_avg_7d
FROM moving_calc
WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 29 DAY) AND DATE '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY order_date ASC

# Question

Welche 3 aktiven Kunden haben in den letzten 30 Tagen vor dem Stichtag den höchsten Deckungsbeitrag erzielt? Gib Kundennummer, Kundensegment, den gesamten Deckungsbeitrag sowie den Rang innerhalb ihres Kundensegments aus.

# SQL

WITH active_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.customer_number, c.segment
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-06-30'
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
),
customer_margins AS (
  SELECT
    ac.customer_number,
    ac.segment,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS total_contribution_margin
  FROM active_customers ac
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.customer_id = ac.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY ac.customer_number, ac.segment
),
ranked_margins AS (
  SELECT
    customer_number,
    segment,
    total_contribution_margin,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY total_contribution_margin DESC) AS rank_in_segment
  FROM customer_margins
)
SELECT
  customer_number,
  segment,
  total_contribution_margin,
  rank_in_segment
FROM ranked_margins
ORDER BY total_contribution_margin DESC, customer_number ASC
LIMIT 3

# Question

Wie hoch war die aggregierte Bestellmenge (Summe aus quantity) je Vertriebskanal (channel_name) im ersten Quartal 2026 im Vergleich zum Vorjahresquartal (erstes Quartal 2025), und wie hoch ist die absolute Differenz (Q1 2026 minus Q1 2025)?

# SQL

WITH quarterly_qty AS (
  SELECT
    c.channel_name,
    d.year,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity
  FROM ecom_v1.channels c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON c.channel_id = o.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.dim_date d ON o.order_date = d.date_key
  WHERE d.quarter = 1 AND d.year IN (2025, 2026)
  GROUP BY c.channel_name, d.year
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN total_quantity END), 0) AS qty_q1_2025,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2026 THEN total_quantity END), 0) AS qty_q1_2026,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2026 THEN total_quantity END), 0) - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN total_quantity END), 0) AS diff_quantity
FROM quarterly_qty
GROUP BY channel_name
ORDER BY channel_name ASC

# Question

Wie viele Bestellungen wurden in den Vertriebskanälen jeweils im ersten Quartal 2025 (2025-01-01 bis 2025-03-31) und im ersten Quartal 2026 (2026-01-01 bis 2026-03-31) aufgegeben, und wie hoch ist die absolute Differenz (Q1 2026 minus Q1 2025)? Bitte Kanäle mit Namen ausgeben, sortiert nach der Anzahl im ersten Quartal 2026 absteigend, bei Gleichstand alphabetisch nach Kanalname.

# SQL

WITH orders_q1 AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31' THEN o.order_id END) AS orders_q1_2025,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31' THEN o.order_id END) AS orders_q1_2026
  FROM ecom_v1.channels ch
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.orders o
    ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31'
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  orders_q1_2025,
  orders_q1_2026,
  orders_q1_2026 - orders_q1_2025 AS diff_abs
FROM orders_q1
ORDER BY orders_q1_2026 DESC, channel_name ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war die Summe aus quantity mal unit_price_gross abzüglich discount_amount je Vertriebskanalname im Kalenderjahr 2024 im Vergleich zum Kalenderjahr 2025, und wie hoch ist die absolute Differenz (2025 minus 2024)?

# SQL

WITH channel_yearly AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS yr,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) AS revenue_gross_discounted
  FROM ecom_v1.channels ch
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name, yr
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    channel_name,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2024 THEN revenue_gross_discounted END), 0) AS amount_2024,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2025 THEN revenue_gross_discounted END), 0) AS amount_2025
  FROM channel_yearly
  GROUP BY channel_name
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  amount_2024,
  amount_2025,
  amount_2025 - amount_2024 AS diff_2025_minus_2024
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY channel_name ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war die Summe aus Menge mal Bruttostückpreis abzüglich Positionsrabatt für jeden Vertriebskanal im ersten Quartal 2026 im Vergleich zum ersten Quartal 2025, und wie hoch ist die absolute Differenz (Q1 2026 minus Q1 2025)?

# SQL

WITH quarterly_sales AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_id,
    ch.channel_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) AS total_gross_after_discount
  FROM ecom_v1.channels AS ch
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders AS o ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31')
  GROUP BY ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name, order_year
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN total_gross_after_discount END), 0) AS gross_sales_q1_2025,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2026 THEN total_gross_after_discount END), 0) AS gross_sales_q1_2026,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2026 THEN total_gross_after_discount END), 0) - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN total_gross_after_discount END), 0) AS difference
FROM quarterly_sales
GROUP BY channel_id, channel_name
ORDER BY channel_name ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war die aggregierte Bestellmenge (Summe aus quantity in order_items) nach Vertriebskanalname im ersten Quartal 2025 verglichen mit dem ersten Quartal 2026, und wie lautet die absolute Differenz (Menge 2026 minus Menge 2025) je Kanal?

# SQL

WITH qty_q1 AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_name,
    d.year,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.dim_date d ON o.order_date = d.date_key
  WHERE d.quarter = 1 AND d.year IN (2025, 2026)
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name, d.year
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN total_quantity END), 0) AS menge_q1_2025,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2026 THEN total_quantity END), 0) AS menge_q1_2026,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2026 THEN total_quantity END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN total_quantity END), 0) AS differenz
FROM qty_q1
GROUP BY channel_name
ORDER BY channel_name ASC

# Question

Wie hoch ist die Summe der Positionswerte (Menge mal Brutto-Einzelpreis abzüglich Positionsrabatt) je Vertriebskanal für das gesamte Jahr 2024 im Vergleich zum gesamten Jahr 2025, und wie lautet die absolute Differenz (2025 minus 2024)? Bitte gib den Kanalnamen, den Wert für 2024, den Wert für 2025 und die Differenz aus, sortiert nach dem Wert von 2025 absteigend.

# SQL

WITH channel_yearly AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_name,
    d.year,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) AS total_gross_value
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.dim_date d ON o.order_date = d.date_key
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  WHERE d.year IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name, d.year
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN total_gross_value END), 0) AS value_2024,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN total_gross_value END), 0) AS value_2025,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN total_gross_value END), 0) - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN total_gross_value END), 0) AS diff_2025_vs_2024
FROM channel_yearly
GROUP BY channel_name
ORDER BY value_2025 DESC, channel_name ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war die Gesamtsumme der Artikelbruttowerte (Menge mal Bruttoeinzelpreis) für die beiden Bestellstatus 'shipped' und 'delivered' jeweils im Kalenderjahr 2024 und im Kalenderjahr 2025, und wie hoch ist die absolute Veränderung von 2024 auf 2025 je Status?

# SQL

WITH yearly_totals AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_status,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross) AS total_gross_value
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status IN ('shipped', 'delivered')
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY o.order_status, order_year
)
SELECT
  order_status,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN total_gross_value ELSE 0 END) AS gross_value_2024,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN total_gross_value ELSE 0 END) AS gross_value_2025,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN total_gross_value ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN total_gross_value ELSE 0 END) AS diff_gross_value
FROM yearly_totals
GROUP BY order_status
ORDER BY order_status ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag im zweiten Quartal 2026 im Vergleich zum zweiten Quartal 2025 je Vertriebskanal, und wie lautet die absolute Veränderung?

# SQL

WITH quarterly_cm AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_name,
    d.year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.dim_date d ON o.order_date = d.date_key
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND d.quarter = 2
    AND d.year IN (2025, 2026)
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name, d.year
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS deckungsbeitrag_q2_2025,
  SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2026 THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS deckungsbeitrag_q2_2026,
  SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2026 THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS diff_absolut
FROM quarterly_cm
GROUP BY channel_name
ORDER BY channel_name ASC

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag im gesamten Jahr 2025 im Vergleich zum Vorjahr 2024 für jeden Vertriebskanal, und wie hoch ist die absolute Veränderung?

# SQL

WITH channel_margin_by_year AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_id,
    ch.channel_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY
    ch.channel_id,
    ch.channel_name,
    order_year
)
SELECT
  c25.channel_id,
  c25.channel_name,
  c24.deckungsbeitrag AS deckungsbeitrag_2024,
  c25.deckungsbeitrag AS deckungsbeitrag_2025,
  (c25.deckungsbeitrag - c24.deckungsbeitrag) AS diff_absolut
FROM channel_margin_by_year c25
JOIN channel_margin_by_year c24
  ON c25.channel_id = c24.channel_id
 AND c25.order_year = 2025
 AND c24.order_year = 2024
ORDER BY
  c25.channel_id ASC;

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag im ersten Quartal 2026 im Vergleich zum Vorjahresquartal (Q1 2025) je Vertriebskanal, und wie hoch ist die absolute Veränderung?

# SQL

WITH channel_q1_margin AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_id,
    ch.channel_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS yr,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.channels ch
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31')
      OR (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31')
    )
  GROUP BY ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name, yr
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2025 THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS deckungsbeitrag_q1_2025,
  SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2026 THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS deckungsbeitrag_q1_2026,
  SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2026 THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2025 THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS diff_absolut
FROM channel_q1_margin
GROUP BY channel_id, channel_name
ORDER BY channel_name ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag im ersten Quartal 2026 im Vergleich zum Vorjahresquartal (Q1 2025) je Vertriebskanal, und wie hoch ist die absolute Differenz zwischen beiden Zeiträumen?

# SQL

WITH quarterly_cm AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_id,
    ch.channel_name,
    d.year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.dim_date d ON o.order_date = d.date_key
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND d.quarter = 1
    AND d.year IN (2025, 2026)
  GROUP BY ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name, d.year
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_q1_2025,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2026 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_q1_2026,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2026 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS diff_absolut
FROM quarterly_cm
GROUP BY channel_id, channel_name
ORDER BY diff_absolut DESC, channel_name ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag im gesamten Jahr 2025 im Vergleich zum Vorjahr 2024 je Vertriebskanal, und wie lautet die absolute Differenz zwischen beiden Jahren?

# SQL

WITH channel_yearly_margin AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_name,
    d.year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS margin
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.dim_date d ON d.date_key = o.order_date
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND d.year IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name, d.year
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN margin END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_2024,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN margin END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_2025,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN margin END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN margin END), 0) AS differenz
FROM channel_yearly_margin
GROUP BY channel_name
ORDER BY differenz DESC, channel_name ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag im gesamten Jahr 2025 im Vergleich zum Vorjahr 2024 nach Vertriebskanal, und wie lautet die absolute Veränderung von 2024 auf 2025 je Kanal?

# SQL

WITH channel_yearly_margin AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_id,
    ch.channel_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY
    ch.channel_id,
    ch.channel_name,
    order_year
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN contribution_margin ELSE 0 END) AS deckungsbeitrag_2024,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN contribution_margin ELSE 0 END) AS deckungsbeitrag_2025,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN contribution_margin ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN contribution_margin ELSE 0 END) AS diff_abs
FROM channel_yearly_margin
GROUP BY
  channel_id,
  channel_name
ORDER BY
  channel_name ASC;

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag im ersten Quartal 2026 im Vergleich zum vierten Quartal 2025 je Vertriebskanal, und wie hoch ist die absolute Veränderung zwischen diesen beiden Quartalen?

# SQL

WITH quarterly_margin AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_name,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' THEN '2025-Q4'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31' THEN '2026-Q1'
    END AS quarter_label,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31'
    )
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name, quarter_label
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quarter_label = '2025-Q4' THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS deckungsbeitrag_q4_2025,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quarter_label = '2026-Q1' THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS deckungsbeitrag_q1_2026,
  SUM(CASE WHEN quarter_label = '2026-Q1' THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN quarter_label = '2025-Q4' THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS diff_absolut
FROM quarterly_margin
GROUP BY channel_name
ORDER BY channel_name ASC

# SQL

WITH refunds AS (
  SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
  FROM ecom_v1.returns
  GROUP BY order_item_id
)

  (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
  - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)
) AS net_revenue_after_returns
FROM ecom_v1.orders o
JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN ecom_v1.categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-01' AND DATE '2026-05-31'
GROUP BY c.category_name
ORDER BY c.category_name

Wie entwickelte sich der Netto-Umsatz von Januar bis Juni 2026 monatlich gegenüber dem Vormonat?

# SQL

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC(o.order_date, MONTH) AS month_start,
    SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY month_start
)
SELECT month_start, net_revenue,
  net_revenue - LAG(net_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS change_from_previous_month
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY month_start

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz je Vertriebskanal im ersten Halbjahr 2026 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2025? Gib für jeden Kanal den Kanalnamen, den Netto-Umsatz H1 2025, den Netto-Umsatz H1 2026 sowie die absolute Differenz und die prozentuale Veränderung aus, sortiert nach dem Kanalnamen.

# SQL

WITH channel_h1_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    c.channel_id,
    c.channel_name,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
        THEN (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS net_revenue_h1_2025,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
        THEN (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS net_revenue_h1_2026
  FROM ecom_v1.channels c
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.orders o
    ON c.channel_id = o.channel_id
   AND o.order_status != 'cancelled'
   AND (
     o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
     OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
   )
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY
    c.channel_id,
    c.channel_name
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  net_revenue_h1_2025,
  net_revenue_h1_2026,
  (net_revenue_h1_2026 - net_revenue_h1_2025) AS absolute_difference,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(net_revenue_h1_2026 - net_revenue_h1_2025, net_revenue_h1_2025) * 100 AS pct_change
FROM channel_h1_revenue
ORDER BY channel_name ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Vertriebskanal im ersten Halbjahr 2026 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2025? Gib den Kanalnamen, den Deckungsbeitrag für H1 2025, den Deckungsbeitrag für H1 2026 sowie die Differenz (H1 2026 minus H1 2025) aus, sortiert nach dem Kanalnamen.

# SQL

WITH channel_h1_margins AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
    )
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name, order_year
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_h1_2025,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2026 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_h1_2026,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2026 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0)
    - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS differenz
FROM channel_h1_margins
GROUP BY channel_name
ORDER BY channel_name ASC

# Question

Welche Produktkategorien konnten ihren Netto-Umsatz im zweiten Quartal 2026 im Vergleich zum zweiten Quartal 2025 steigern? Gib die Kategorie, den Netto-Umsatz im Q2 2025, den Netto-Umsatz im Q2 2026 sowie die Differenz (Q2 2026 minus Q2 2025) aus, sortiert nach der Differenz absteigend.

# SQL

WITH quarterly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    c.category_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate) ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_q2_2025,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate) ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_q2_2026
  FROM ecom_v1.categories c
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30')
  GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
)
SELECT
  category_name,
  net_revenue_q2_2025,
  net_revenue_q2_2026,
  net_revenue_q2_2026 - net_revenue_q2_2025 AS diff_revenue
FROM quarterly_revenue
WHERE net_revenue_q2_2026 > net_revenue_q2_2025
ORDER BY diff_revenue DESC, category_name ASC

# Question

Welche drei Vertriebskanäle erzielten in den 90 Tagen bis einschließlich zum 30.06.2026 den höchsten Deckungsbeitrag? Gib jeweils den Kanalnamen und den Deckungsbeitrag aus und verwende eine Window-Funktion für das Ranking.

# SQL

WITH channel_margin AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_name,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name
),
ranked_channels AS (
  SELECT
    channel_name,
    deckungsbeitrag,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY deckungsbeitrag DESC, channel_name ASC) AS rnk
  FROM channel_margin
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  deckungsbeitrag
FROM ranked_channels
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY deckungsbeitrag DESC, channel_name ASC

# Question

Berechne für jede Produktkategorie die Retourenquote im Kalenderjahr 2025, definiert als Summe der retournierten Einheiten geteilt durch die Summe der verkauften Einheiten basierend auf dem Bestelldatum. Berücksichtige nur nicht stornierte Bestellungen sowie Kategorien mit mindestens einer verkauften Einheit und gib den Kategorienamen, die verkauften Einheiten, die retournierten Einheiten und die Retourenquote aus, sortiert nach der Retourenquote in absteigender Reihenfolge sowie bei Gleichstand nach dem Kategorienamen aufsteigend.

# SQL

WITH sales_and_returns AS (
  SELECT
    p.category_id,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
    COALESCE(SUM(r.quantity_returned), 0) AS units_returned
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.returns r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY p.category_id
)
SELECT
  c.category_name,
  sr.units_sold,
  sr.units_returned,
  ROUND(CAST(sr.units_returned AS NUMERIC) / CAST(sr.units_sold AS NUMERIC), 4) AS return_rate
FROM sales_and_returns sr
JOIN ecom_v1.categories c ON sr.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE sr.units_sold > 0
ORDER BY return_rate DESC, c.category_name ASC

# Question

Welche drei Kategorien verzeichneten im zweiten Quartal 2026 den höchsten Anteil an noch nicht versendeten Bestellungen? Ermittle mithilfe einer Fensterfunktion für das Ranking die Kategorie, die Gesamtzahl aller Bestellungen, die Anzahl der unversendeten Bestellungen sowie deren Anteil.

# SQL

WITH category_orders AS (
  SELECT
    c.category_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.ship_date IS NULL THEN o.order_id END) AS unshipped_orders,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.ship_date IS NULL THEN o.order_id END),
      COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id)
    ) AS unshipped_ratio
  FROM ecom_v1.categories c
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY c.category_name
),
ranked_categories AS (
  SELECT
    category_name,
    total_orders,
    unshipped_orders,
    unshipped_ratio,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY unshipped_ratio DESC, total_orders DESC, category_name ASC) AS rnk
  FROM category_orders
)
SELECT
  category_name,
  total_orders,
  unshipped_orders,
  unshipped_ratio
FROM ranked_categories
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY unshipped_ratio DESC, total_orders DESC, category_name ASC

# Question

Welcher Monat hatte im Kalenderjahr 2025 je Zahlungsmethode die meisten Bestellungen? Gib für jede Zahlungsmethode genau diesen Monat im Format 'YYYY-MM' zusammen mit der Anzahl der Bestellungen aus (bei Gleichstand entscheidet der frühere Monat).

# SQL

WITH monthly_orders AS (
  SELECT
    payment_method,
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', order_date) AS order_month,
    COUNT(order_id) AS order_count
  FROM ecom_v1.orders
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY payment_method, FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', order_date)
),
ranked_months AS (
  SELECT
    payment_method,
    order_month,
    order_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY payment_method
      ORDER BY order_count DESC, order_month ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM monthly_orders
)
SELECT
  payment_method,
  order_month,
  order_count
FROM ranked_months
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY payment_method ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz je Vertriebskanal im ersten Halbjahr 2026 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2025? Gib den Kanalnamen, den Netto-Umsatz für H1 2025, den Netto-Umsatz für H1 2026 sowie die absolute Differenz und die prozentuale Veränderung aus.

# SQL

WITH channel_h1_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    c.channel_id,
    c.channel_name,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
        THEN (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS net_revenue_h1_2025,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
        THEN (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS net_revenue_h1_2026
  FROM ecom_v1.channels c
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.orders o
    ON c.channel_id = o.channel_id
   AND o.order_status != 'cancelled'
   AND (
     o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
     OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
   )
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, c.channel_name
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  net_revenue_h1_2025,
  net_revenue_h1_2026,
  (net_revenue_h1_2026 - net_revenue_h1_2025) AS diff_abs,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(net_revenue_h1_2026 - net_revenue_h1_2025, net_revenue_h1_2025) * 100 AS diff_pct
FROM channel_h1_revenue
ORDER BY channel_name ASC;

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz je Produktkategorie im ersten Halbjahr 2026 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2025? Gib für jede Kategorie den Namen, den Netto-Umsatz H1 2025, den Netto-Umsatz H1 2026 sowie die absolute Differenz und die prozentuale Veränderung an.

WITH category_sales AS (
  SELECT
    c.category_id,
    c.category_name,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
        THEN (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS net_revenue_h1_2025,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
        THEN (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS net_revenue_h1_2026
  FROM ecom_v1.categories c
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'

  SAFE_DIVIDE(net_revenue_h1_2026 - net_revenue_h1_2025, net_revenue_h1_2025) * 100 AS percentage_change
FROM category_sales

  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id

      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-12-31'
    )

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz je Land im ersten Halbjahr 2026 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2025? Gib für jedes Land den Netto-Umsatz im H1 2025, den Netto-Umsatz im H1 2026, die absolute Differenz sowie die prozentuale Veränderung aus, sortiert nach dem Ländercode.

# SQL

WITH revenue_by_period AS (
  SELECT
    c.country_code,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
             THEN (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
             ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_h1_2025,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
             THEN (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
             ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_h1_2026
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
         OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30')
  GROUP BY c.country_code
)
SELECT
  country_code,
  net_revenue_h1_2025,
  net_revenue_h1_2026,
  (net_revenue_h1_2026 - net_revenue_h1_2025) AS diff_abs,
  CASE
    WHEN net_revenue_h1_2025 = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ((net_revenue_h1_2026 - net_revenue_h1_2025) / net_revenue_h1_2025) * 100
  END AS pct_change
FROM revenue_by_period
ORDER BY country_code ASC;

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz je Vertriebskanal im ersten Quartal 2026 im Vergleich zum Vorjahresquartal Q1 2025? Gib den Kanalnamen, den Netto-Umsatz für Q1 2025 und Q1 2026, die absolute Differenz sowie die prozentuale Veränderung aus, sortiert nach dem Kanalnamen.

# SQL

WITH revenue_by_period AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.channels ch
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31')
      OR (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31')
    )
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name, order_year
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_name,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN r.order_year = 2025 THEN r.net_revenue END), 0) AS net_revenue_q1_2025,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN r.order_year = 2026 THEN r.net_revenue END), 0) AS net_revenue_q1_2026
  FROM ecom_v1.channels ch
  LEFT JOIN revenue_by_period r ON ch.channel_name = r.channel_name
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  net_revenue_q1_2025,
  net_revenue_q1_2026,
  net_revenue_q1_2026 - net_revenue_q1_2025 AS abs_diff,
  SAFE_DIVIDE((net_revenue_q1_2026 - net_revenue_q1_2025), net_revenue_q1_2025) * 100 AS pct_change
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY channel_name ASC

WITH quarterly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    c.category_id,
    c.category_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate) ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_q2_2025,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate) ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_q2_2026

  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id AND o.order_status != 'cancelled'

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Vertriebskanal im ersten Halbjahr 2026 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2025, und wie hoch ist die absolute Differenz? Bitte nach Vertriebskanal gruppieren und die Glossardefinition inklusive Partnerprovision anwenden.

# SQL

WITH margin_by_channel_period AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_id,
    ch.channel_name,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN 'H1_2025'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN 'H1_2026'
    END AS period,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.channels ch
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
    )
  GROUP BY ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name, period
)
SELECT
  channel_id,
  channel_name,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2025' THEN contribution_margin END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_h1_2025,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2026' THEN contribution_margin END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_h1_2026,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2026' THEN contribution_margin END), 0)
    - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2025' THEN contribution_margin END), 0) AS differenz
FROM margin_by_channel_period
GROUP BY channel_id, channel_name
ORDER BY channel_id ASC

Vergleiche den Deckungsbeitrag je Produktkategorie im ersten Halbjahr 2026 mit dem gleichen Zeitraum 2025. Gib den Kategorienamen, den Deckungsbeitrag H1 2025, den Deckungsbeitrag H1 2026 sowie die Differenz (2026 minus 2025) aus und wende dabei die Glossardefinition inklusive Partnerprovision an.

# SQL

WITH margin_by_category_period AS (
  SELECT
    cat.category_id,
    cat.category_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30')
      OR (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30')
    )
  GROUP BY cat.category_id, cat.category_name, order_year
)

  category_name,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_h1_2025,

FROM margin_by_category_period

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Zahlungsmethode im ersten Halbjahr 2026 im Vergleich zum Vorjahreszeitraum (erstes Halbjahr 2025), und wie hoch ist die absolute Differenz (2026 minus 2025)?

# SQL

WITH margin_by_period AS (
  SELECT
    o.payment_method,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 0 END) AS deckungsbeitrag_h1_2025,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 0 END) AS deckungsbeitrag_h1_2026
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
    )
  GROUP BY o.payment_method
)
SELECT
  payment_method,
  deckungsbeitrag_h1_2025,
  deckungsbeitrag_h1_2026,
  deckungsbeitrag_h1_2026 - deckungsbeitrag_h1_2025 AS differenz
FROM margin_by_period
ORDER BY payment_method ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Kundenland im zweiten Halbjahr 2025 verglichen mit dem zweiten Halbjahr 2026? Gib das Land, den Deckungsbeitrag für H2 2025, den Deckungsbeitrag für H2 2026 sowie die absolute Veränderung (H2 2026 minus H2 2025) aus, sortiert nach Land.

# SQL

WITH contribution_by_period AS (
  SELECT
    c.country_code,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' THEN '2025_H2'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-12-31' THEN '2026_H2'
    END AS period,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - (oi.quantity * p.purchase_price)
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-12-31'
    )
)
SELECT
  country_code,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2025_H2' THEN contribution_margin END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_2025_h2,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026_H2' THEN contribution_margin END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_2026_h2,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026_H2' THEN contribution_margin END), 0)
    - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2025_H2' THEN contribution_margin END), 0) AS differenz
FROM contribution_by_period
GROUP BY country_code
ORDER BY country_code ASC;

WITH margin_by_period AS (
  SELECT
    c.segment,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN 'h1_2025'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN 'h1_2026'
    END AS period,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
    )

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Vertriebskanal im ersten Quartal 2026 im Vergleich zum ersten Quartal 2025, und wie hoch ist die absolute Differenz zwischen beiden Zeiträumen?

# SQL

WITH cm_per_item AS (
  SELECT
    o.channel_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31')
      OR (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31')
    )
),
cm_aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    channel_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN contribution_margin ELSE 0 END) AS deckungsbeitrag_q1_2025,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2026 THEN contribution_margin ELSE 0 END) AS deckungsbeitrag_q1_2026
  FROM cm_per_item
  GROUP BY channel_id
)
SELECT
  ch.channel_name,
  COALESCE(cma.deckungsbeitrag_q1_2025, 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_q1_2025,
  COALESCE(cma.deckungsbeitrag_q1_2026, 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_q1_2026,
  COALESCE(cma.deckungsbeitrag_q1_2026, 0) - COALESCE(cma.deckungsbeitrag_q1_2025, 0) AS differenz
FROM ecom_v1.channels ch
LEFT JOIN cm_aggregated cma ON ch.channel_id = cma.channel_id
ORDER BY ch.channel_name ASC;
