# Question

Welche drei Vertriebskanäle erzielten im Kalenderjahr 2025 den höchsten Netto-Umsatz nach Abzug von Retouren? Gib den Namen des Vertriebskanals, den berechneten Netto-Umsatz sowie den Rang an und sortiere das Ergebnis aufsteigend nach dem Rang.

# SQL

WITH channel_net_rev AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_name,
    SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) - COALESCE(SUM(ret.total_refund), 0) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.channels ch
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      order_item_id,
      SUM(refund_amount) AS total_refund
    FROM ecom_v1.returns
    GROUP BY order_item_id
  ) ret ON oi.order_item_id = ret.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name
),
ranked_channels AS (
  SELECT
    channel_name,
    net_revenue,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_revenue DESC) AS rank_pos
  FROM channel_net_rev
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  net_revenue,
  rank_pos
FROM ranked_channels
WHERE rank_pos <= 3
ORDER BY rank_pos ASC, channel_name ASC

# Question

Welche drei Kundensegmente erzielten im Kalenderjahr 2025 den höchsten Netto-Umsatz nach Abzug von Retouren? Gib das Kundensegment, den berechneten Netto-Umsatz sowie den Rang an und verwende dafür eine Window-Funktion.

# SQL

WITH segment_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    c.segment,
    SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) - COALESCE(SUM(r.total_refund), 0) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      order_item_id,
      SUM(refund_amount) AS total_refund
    FROM ecom_v1.returns
    GROUP BY order_item_id
  ) r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY c.segment
),
ranked_segments AS (
  SELECT
    segment,
    net_revenue,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, segment ASC) AS rank_pos
  FROM segment_revenue
)
SELECT
  segment,
  net_revenue,
  rank_pos
FROM ranked_segments
WHERE rank_pos <= 3
ORDER BY rank_pos ASC, segment ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war im Kalenderjahr 2024 die Retourenquote je Produktkategorie, berechnet als retournierte Einheiten geteilt durch verkaufte Einheiten? Gib den Kategorienamen, die Anzahl der verkauften Einheiten, die Anzahl der retournierten Einheiten sowie die Retourenquote aus, beschränkt auf Kategorien mit mindestens einer verkauften Einheit und absteigend sortiert nach der Retourenquote.

# SQL

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT
    p.category_id,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold_units
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
  GROUP BY p.category_id
),
ret AS (
  SELECT
    p.category_id,
    SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS returned_units
  FROM ecom_v1.returns r
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
  GROUP BY p.category_id
)
SELECT
  c.category_name,
  s.sold_units,
  COALESCE(r.returned_units, 0) AS returned_units,
  COALESCE(r.returned_units, 0) / s.sold_units AS return_rate
FROM sales s
JOIN ecom_v1.categories c ON c.category_id = s.category_id
LEFT JOIN ret r ON r.category_id = s.category_id
WHERE s.sold_units > 0
ORDER BY return_rate DESC, c.category_name ASC

# Question

Ermittle je Vertriebskanal die Retourenquote im Kalenderjahr 2025 als retournierte Einheiten geteilt durch verkaufte Einheiten. Gib nur Kanäle mit verkauften Einheiten aus und sortiere absteigend nach Quote.

# SQL

WITH channel_sales AS (
  SELECT
    c.channel_id,
    c.channel_name,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold_units
  FROM ecom_v1.channels c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON c.channel_id = o.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, c.channel_name
),
channel_returns AS (
  SELECT
    c.channel_id,
    SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS returned_units
  FROM ecom_v1.channels c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON c.channel_id = o.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.returns r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id
)
SELECT
  cs.channel_name,
  cs.sold_units,
  COALESCE(cr.returned_units, 0) AS returned_units,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(cr.returned_units, 0), cs.sold_units) AS return_rate
FROM channel_sales cs
LEFT JOIN channel_returns cr ON cs.channel_id = cr.channel_id
WHERE cs.sold_units > 0
ORDER BY return_rate DESC, cs.channel_name ASC

# Question

Welcher Kalendermonat wies im Kalenderjahr 2024 je Zahlungsmethode die höchste Anzahl an Bestellungen auf? Ermittle je Zahlungsmethode genau diesen Spitzenmonat inklusive der jeweiligen Bestellanzahl.

WITH monthly_orders AS (
  SELECT
    payment_method,
    DATE_TRUNC(order_date, MONTH) AS order_month,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count

  GROUP BY payment_method, order_month
),
ranked_months AS (
  SELECT
    payment_method,
    order_month,
    order_count,

    ) AS rn
  FROM monthly_orders
)
SELECT
  payment_method,
  order_month,
  order_count
FROM ranked_months
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY payment_method ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz je Vertriebskanal im ersten Halbjahr 2025 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2024? Gib den Kanalnamen, den Netto-Umsatz im H1 2024, den Netto-Umsatz im H1 2025 sowie die Differenz (2025 minus 2024) aus, sortiert nach dem Kanalnamen.

# SQL

WITH channel_h1_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30'
             THEN (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
             ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_h1_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
             THEN (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
             ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_h1_2025
  FROM ecom_v1.channels ch
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
    )
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  net_revenue_h1_2024,
  net_revenue_h1_2025,
  (net_revenue_h1_2025 - net_revenue_h1_2024) AS diff_revenue
FROM channel_h1_revenue
ORDER BY channel_name ASC

WITH channel_h1_revenue AS (

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz je Vertriebskanal im ersten Halbjahr 2025 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2024? Gib den Kanalnamen, den Netto-Umsatz H1 2024, den Netto-Umsatz H1 2025 sowie die absolute Differenz (H1 2025 minus H1 2024) aus, sortiert nach dem Kanalnamen.

# SQL

WITH channel_halfyear_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.channels ch
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o
    ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
    )
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name, order_year
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN net_revenue END), 0) AS net_revenue_h1_2024,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN net_revenue END), 0) AS net_revenue_h1_2025,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN net_revenue END), 0)
    - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN net_revenue END), 0) AS diff_revenue
FROM channel_halfyear_revenue
GROUP BY channel_name
ORDER BY channel_name ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz je Vertriebskanal im ersten Halbjahr 2025 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2024? Gib den Namen des Kanals, den Netto-Umsatz im H1 2024, den Netto-Umsatz im H1 2025 sowie die Differenz (H1 2025 minus H1 2024) aus, sortiert nach der Differenz absteigend.

# SQL

WITH channel_h1_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_id,
    ch.channel_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30'
             THEN (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
             ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_h1_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
             THEN (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
             ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_h1_2025
  FROM ecom_v1.channels ch
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.orders o
    ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
   AND o.order_status != 'cancelled'
   AND (
     o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30'
     OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
   )
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  ROUND(net_revenue_h1_2024, 2) AS net_revenue_h1_2024,
  ROUND(net_revenue_h1_2025, 2) AS net_revenue_h1_2025,
  ROUND(net_revenue_h1_2025 - net_revenue_h1_2024, 2) AS diff_revenue
FROM channel_h1_revenue
ORDER BY diff_revenue DESC, channel_name ASC;

# SQL

WITH margin_base AS (
  SELECT
    cat.category_id,
    cat.category_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - (oi.quantity * p.purchase_price)
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END AS line_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30')
      OR (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30')
    )
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    category_id,
    category_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN line_margin END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_h1_2024,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN line_margin END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_h1_2025
  FROM margin_base
  GROUP BY category_id, category_name
)
SELECT
  category_name,
  deckungsbeitrag_h1_2024,
  deckungsbeitrag_h1_2025,
  (deckungsbeitrag_h1_2025 - deckungsbeitrag_h1_2024) AS differenz
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY differenz DESC, category_name ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Produktkategorie im ersten Halbjahr 2024 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2025? Gib den Kategorienamen, den Deckungsbeitrag für H1 2024, den Deckungsbeitrag für H1 2025 sowie die absolute Differenz (H1 2025 minus H1 2024) aus, sortiert nach der Differenz in absteigender Reihenfolge.

# SQL

WITH contribution_margin_base AS (
  SELECT
    cat.category_id,
    cat.category_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END AS line_contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30')
      OR (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30')
    )
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    category_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN line_contribution_margin ELSE 0 END) AS deckungsbeitrag_h1_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN line_contribution_margin ELSE 0 END) AS deckungsbeitrag_h1_2025
  FROM contribution_margin_base
  GROUP BY category_id, category_name
)
SELECT
  category_name,
  deckungsbeitrag_h1_2024,
  deckungsbeitrag_h1_2025,
  (deckungsbeitrag_h1_2025 - deckungsbeitrag_h1_2024) AS differenz
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY differenz DESC, category_name ASC

  SELECT
    p.category_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS yr,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS db
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30')
      OR (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30')

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Produktkategorie im ersten Halbjahr 2025 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2024? Gib den Kategorienamen, den Deckungsbeitrag für H1 2024, den Deckungsbeitrag für H1 2025 sowie die absolute Differenz (2025 minus 2024) aus, sortiert nach der Differenz in absteigender Reihenfolge.

# SQL

WITH margin_base AS (
  SELECT
    c.category_id,
    c.category_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30')
      OR (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30')
    )
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    category_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN contribution_margin ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_h1_2024,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN contribution_margin ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_h1_2025
  FROM margin_base
  GROUP BY category_id, category_name
)
SELECT
  category_name,
  deckungsbeitrag_h1_2024,
  deckungsbeitrag_h1_2025,
  (deckungsbeitrag_h1_2025 - deckungsbeitrag_h1_2024) AS differenz
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY differenz DESC, category_name ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz je Zahlungsmethode im ersten Quartal 2026 im Vergleich zum ersten Quartal 2025? Gib für jede Zahlungsmethode den Netto-Umsatz für Q1 2025 und Q1 2026 sowie die Differenz (Q1 2026 minus Q1 2025) aus, sortiert nach der Zahlungsmethode.

# SQL

WITH q1_sales AS (
  SELECT
    o.payment_method,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS yr,
    SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31')
      OR (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31')
    )
  GROUP BY o.payment_method, yr
)
SELECT
  p.payment_method,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN q.yr = 2025 THEN q.net_revenue END), 0) AS net_revenue_q1_2025,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN q.yr = 2026 THEN q.net_revenue END), 0) AS net_revenue_q1_2026,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN q.yr = 2026 THEN q.net_revenue END), 0) - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN q.yr = 2025 THEN q.net_revenue END), 0) AS diff_revenue
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT payment_method FROM ecom_v1.orders
) p
LEFT JOIN q1_sales q ON p.payment_method = q.payment_method
GROUP BY p.payment_method
ORDER BY p.payment_method ASC

WITH revenue_by_period AS (
  SELECT
    o.payment_method,
    d.year,
    SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o

FROM revenue_by_period p

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz je Zahlungsmethode im ersten Quartal 2026 im Vergleich zum ersten Quartal 2025, und wie hoch ist die absolute Differenz (2026 minus 2025)?

# SQL

WITH quarterly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    o.payment_method,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.orders AS o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items AS oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31'
    )
  GROUP BY
    o.payment_method,
    order_year
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(q26.payment_method, q25.payment_method) AS payment_method,
  COALESCE(q25.net_revenue, 0) AS net_revenue_q1_2025,
  COALESCE(q26.net_revenue, 0) AS net_revenue_q1_2026,
  COALESCE(q26.net_revenue, 0) - COALESCE(q25.net_revenue, 0) AS difference
FROM (
  SELECT payment_method, net_revenue
  FROM quarterly_revenue
  WHERE order_year = 2025
) AS q25
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT payment_method, net_revenue
  FROM quarterly_revenue
  WHERE order_year = 2026
) AS q26
  ON q25.payment_method = q26.payment_method
ORDER BY
  payment_method ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Vertriebskanal im zweiten Quartal 2026 im Vergleich zum zweiten Quartal 2025? Gib für jeden Kanal den Kanalnamen, den Deckungsbeitrag für Q2 2025, den Deckungsbeitrag für Q2 2026 sowie die Differenz (Q2 2026 minus Q2 2025) aus, sortiert nach dem Kanalnamen.

# SQL

WITH channel_quarterly_cm AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_id,
    ch.channel_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS cm
  FROM ecom_v1.channels ch
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30')
      OR (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30')
    )
  GROUP BY ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name, order_year
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN cm END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_q2_2025,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2026 THEN cm END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_q2_2026,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2026 THEN cm END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN cm END), 0) AS differenz
FROM channel_quarterly_cm
GROUP BY channel_id, channel_name
ORDER BY channel_name ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Vertriebskanal im 2. Quartal 2026 im Vergleich zum 2. Quartal 2025, und wie hoch ist die absolute Differenz (2026 minus 2025)?

# SQL

WITH quarterly_cm AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS yr,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
    )
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name, yr
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2025 THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS deckungsbeitrag_q2_2025,
  SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2026 THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS deckungsbeitrag_q2_2026,
  SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2026 THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2025 THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS diff_deckungsbeitrag
FROM quarterly_cm
GROUP BY channel_name
ORDER BY channel_name ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Vertriebskanal im zweiten Quartal 2026 im Vergleich zum zweiten Quartal 2025? Gib für jeden Kanal den Namen, den Deckungsbeitrag in Q2 2025, den Deckungsbeitrag in Q2 2026 sowie die Differenz (Q2 2026 minus Q2 2025) aus, sortiert nach dem Kanalnamen.

# SQL

WITH quarterly_margin AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_id,
    ch.channel_name,
    d.year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS total_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.dim_date d ON d.date_key = o.order_date
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND d.quarter = 2
    AND d.year IN (2025, 2026)
  GROUP BY ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name, d.year
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN total_margin END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_q2_2025,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2026 THEN total_margin END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_q2_2026,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2026 THEN total_margin END), 0)
    - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN total_margin END), 0) AS differenz
FROM quarterly_margin
GROUP BY channel_id, channel_name
ORDER BY channel_name ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Vertriebskanal im zweiten Quartal 2026 im Vergleich zum zweiten Quartal 2025? Gib für jeden Kanal den Deckungsbeitrag 2025, den Deckungsbeitrag 2026 sowie die Differenz (2026 minus 2025) aus, sortiert nach dem Kanalnamen.

# SQL

WITH channel_quarterly_cm AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_id,
    ch.channel_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
    )
  GROUP BY ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name, order_year
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_2025_q2,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2026 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_2026_q2,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2026 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0)
    - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS differenz
FROM channel_quarterly_cm
GROUP BY channel_id, channel_name
ORDER BY channel_name ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz je Land im ersten Halbjahr 2025 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2024? Gib den Ländercode, den Netto-Umsatz für H1 2024, den Netto-Umsatz für H1 2025 sowie die absolute Differenz und die prozentuale Veränderung aus (Division durch null sicher abfangen), sortiert nach dem Ländercode.

# SQL

WITH revenue_by_period AS (
  SELECT
    c.country_code,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30'
             THEN (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
             ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_h1_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
             THEN (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
             ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_h1_2025
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30'
         OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30')
  GROUP BY c.country_code
)
SELECT
  country_code,
  net_revenue_h1_2024,
  net_revenue_h1_2025,
  (net_revenue_h1_2025 - net_revenue_h1_2024) AS diff_abs,
  SAFE_DIVIDE((net_revenue_h1_2025 - net_revenue_h1_2024), net_revenue_h1_2024) * 100 AS diff_pct
FROM revenue_by_period
ORDER BY country_code ASC;

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz je Land im ersten Halbjahr 2025 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2024? Gib den Ländercode, den Netto-Umsatz H1 2024, den Netto-Umsatz H1 2025, die absolute Differenz sowie die prozentuale Veränderung aus, sortiert nach dem Ländercode.

# SQL

WITH h1_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    c.country_code,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30')
      OR (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30')
    )
  GROUP BY c.country_code, order_year
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    country_code,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN net_revenue END), 0) AS net_revenue_h1_2024,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN net_revenue END), 0) AS net_revenue_h1_2025
  FROM h1_revenue
  GROUP BY country_code
)
SELECT
  country_code,
  net_revenue_h1_2024,
  net_revenue_h1_2025,
  (net_revenue_h1_2025 - net_revenue_h1_2024) AS diff_abs,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(net_revenue_h1_2025 - net_revenue_h1_2024, net_revenue_h1_2024) * 100 AS pct_change
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY country_code ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz je Kundenland im ersten Halbjahr 2025 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2024? Gib je Land den Netto-Umsatz für H1 2024 und H1 2025, die absolute Differenz sowie die prozentuale Veränderung aus (Division durch null sicher abfangen).

# SQL

WITH revenue_per_halfyear AS (
  SELECT
    c.country_code,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
    )
  GROUP BY c.country_code, order_year
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    country_code,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN net_revenue END), 0) AS net_revenue_h1_2024,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN net_revenue END), 0) AS net_revenue_h1_2025
  FROM revenue_per_halfyear
  GROUP BY country_code
)
SELECT
  country_code,
  net_revenue_h1_2024,
  net_revenue_h1_2025,
  net_revenue_h1_2025 - net_revenue_h1_2024 AS diff_abs,
  CASE
    WHEN net_revenue_h1_2024 = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ((net_revenue_h1_2025 - net_revenue_h1_2024) / net_revenue_h1_2024) * 100
  END AS diff_pct
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY country_code ASC;

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz je Land im ersten Halbjahr 2025 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2024? Gib den Ländercode, den Netto-Umsatz H1 2024, den Netto-Umsatz H1 2025, die absolute Veränderung sowie die prozentuale Veränderung aus, sortiert nach Ländercode.

# SQL

WITH revenue_by_period AS (
  SELECT
    c.country_code,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30' THEN '2024_H1'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN '2025_H1'
    END AS period,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate) AS item_net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
    )
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    country_code,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2024_H1' THEN item_net_revenue END), 0) AS net_revenue_2024_h1,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2025_H1' THEN item_net_revenue END), 0) AS net_revenue_2025_h1
  FROM revenue_by_period
  GROUP BY country_code
)
SELECT
  country_code,
  net_revenue_2024_h1,
  net_revenue_2025_h1,
  net_revenue_2025_h1 - net_revenue_2024_h1 AS absolute_diff,
  CASE
    WHEN net_revenue_2024_h1 = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ((net_revenue_2025_h1 - net_revenue_2024_h1) / net_revenue_2024_h1) * 100
  END AS pct_change
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY country_code ASC

  FROM ecom_v1.customers c

WITH revenue_h1 AS (
  SELECT
    c.country_code,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id

    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30'

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Zahlungsmethode im ersten Halbjahr 2025 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2024? Gib je Zahlungsmethode den Deckungsbeitrag für H1 2024, H1 2025, die absolute Differenz sowie die prozentuale Veränderung aus, sortiert nach der Zahlungsmethode.

# SQL

WITH margin_by_payment_period AS (
  SELECT
    o.payment_method,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.orders AS o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels AS ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
    )
  GROUP BY o.payment_method, order_year
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    payment_method,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN contribution_margin ELSE 0 END) AS contribution_margin_2024_h1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN contribution_margin ELSE 0 END) AS contribution_margin_2025_h1
  FROM margin_by_payment_period
  GROUP BY payment_method
)
SELECT
  payment_method,
  contribution_margin_2024_h1,
  contribution_margin_2025_h1,
  contribution_margin_2025_h1 - contribution_margin_2024_h1 AS absolute_difference,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    contribution_margin_2025_h1 - contribution_margin_2024_h1,
    contribution_margin_2024_h1
  ) * 100 AS percentage_change
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY payment_method ASC

WITH margin_base AS (
  SELECT
    o.payment_method,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30' THEN '2024_h1'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN '2025_h1'
    END AS period,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (

      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Zahlungsmethode im ersten Halbjahr 2025 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2024? Gib je Zahlungsmethode den Deckungsbeitrag für H1 2024, für H1 2025, die absolute Differenz sowie die prozentuale Veränderung aus, berechne dies mittels CTEs, fange Division durch null sicher ab und sortiere absteigend nach dem Deckungsbeitrag in H1 2025.

# SQL

WITH margin_base AS (
  SELECT
    o.payment_method,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS total_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
    )
  GROUP BY o.payment_method, order_year
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    payment_method,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN total_margin END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_h1_2024,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN total_margin END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_h1_2025
  FROM margin_base
  GROUP BY payment_method
)
SELECT
  payment_method,
  deckungsbeitrag_h1_2024,
  deckungsbeitrag_h1_2025,
  deckungsbeitrag_h1_2025 - deckungsbeitrag_h1_2024 AS diff_absolut,
  SAFE_DIVIDE((deckungsbeitrag_h1_2025 - deckungsbeitrag_h1_2024), deckungsbeitrag_h1_2024) * 100 AS pct_change
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY deckungsbeitrag_h1_2025 DESC, payment_method ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz je Kundensegment im zweiten Quartal 2026 im Vergleich zum zweiten Quartal 2025? Gib das Kundensegment, den Netto-Umsatz für Q2 2025 und Q2 2026, die absolute Differenz sowie die prozentuale Veränderung aus.

# SQL

WITH segment_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    c.segment,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30')
      OR (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30')
    )
  GROUP BY c.segment, order_year
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    segment,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN net_revenue END), 0) AS net_revenue_q2_2025,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2026 THEN net_revenue END), 0) AS net_revenue_q2_2026
  FROM segment_revenue
  GROUP BY segment
)
SELECT
  segment,
  net_revenue_q2_2025,
  net_revenue_q2_2026,
  (net_revenue_q2_2026 - net_revenue_q2_2025) AS diff_abs,
  SAFE_DIVIDE((net_revenue_q2_2026 - net_revenue_q2_2025) * 100, net_revenue_q2_2025) AS diff_pct
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY segment ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Produktkategorie im ersten Quartal 2026 im Vergleich zum ersten Quartal 2025? Gib Kategorie-ID, Kategoriename, den Deckungsbeitrag für Q1 2025 und Q1 2026 sowie die absolute Differenz und die prozentuale Veränderung aus.

# SQL

WITH q1_margins AS (
  SELECT
    c.category_id,
    c.category_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31')
      OR (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31')
    )
  GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name, order_year
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    category_id,
    category_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_q1_2025,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2026 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_q1_2026
  FROM q1_margins
  GROUP BY category_id, category_name
)
SELECT
  category_id,
  category_name,
  deckungsbeitrag_q1_2025,
  deckungsbeitrag_q1_2026,
  (deckungsbeitrag_q1_2026 - deckungsbeitrag_q1_2025) AS diff_absolut,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(deckungsbeitrag_q1_2026 - deckungsbeitrag_q1_2025, deckungsbeitrag_q1_2025) * 100 AS diff_prozent
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY category_id

WITH margin_by_period AS (
  SELECT
    c.category_id,
    c.category_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'

FROM pivoted
ORDER BY
  category_name ASC

# Question

Berechne den Deckungsbeitrag je Produktkategorie für das erste Quartal 2026 im Vergleich zum ersten Quartal 2025. Gib den Kategorienamen, den Deckungsbeitrag für Q1 2025, den Deckungsbeitrag für Q1 2026, die absolute Differenz (2026 minus 2025) sowie die prozentuale Veränderung aus, sortiert nach dem Deckungsbeitrag 2026 absteigend.

# SQL

WITH quarterly_cm AS (
  SELECT
    c.category_id,
    c.category_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS yr,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31')
      OR (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31')
    )
  GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name, yr
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    category_id,
    category_name,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2025 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_q1_2025,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2026 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_q1_2026
  FROM quarterly_cm
  GROUP BY category_id, category_name
)

  category_name,
  deckungsbeitrag_q1_2025,
  deckungsbeitrag_q1_2026,
  (deckungsbeitrag_q1_2026 - deckungsbeitrag_q1_2025) AS diff_absolut,
  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      deckungsbeitrag_q1_2026 - deckungsbeitrag_q1_2025,
      NULLIF(ABS(deckungsbeitrag_q1_2025), 0)
    ) * 100,
    2
  ) AS diff_prozentual
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY deckungsbeitrag_q1_2026 DESC, category_name ASC;

  SELECT
    p.category_id,

      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'

          ELSE 0
        END AS item_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id

  SELECT
    c.category_id,
    c.category_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31')
      OR (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31')
    )
  GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name, order_year
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    category_id,
    category_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS deckungsbeitrag_q1_2025,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2026 THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS deckungsbeitrag_q1_2026
  FROM q1_metrics
  GROUP BY category_id, category_name
)
SELECT
  category_id,
  category_name,
  deckungsbeitrag_q1_2025,
  deckungsbeitrag_q1_2026,
  deckungsbeitrag_q1_2026 - deckungsbeitrag_q1_2025 AS diff_abs,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(deckungsbeitrag_q1_2026 - deckungsbeitrag_q1_2025, deckungsbeitrag_q1_2025) * 100 AS pct_change
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY category_id

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz je Kundensegment im Oktober 2025 (ohne Berücksichtigung von Retourenabzügen), und wie hoch ist der prozentuale Anteil jedes Segments am gesamten Netto-Umsatz dieses Monats?

# SQL

WITH segment_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    c.segment,
    SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY c.segment
)
SELECT
  segment,
  net_revenue,
  net_revenue / SUM(net_revenue) OVER () AS share_of_total
FROM segment_revenue
ORDER BY segment ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz je Vertriebskanal im Januar 2024 (gemäß Glossar mit Storno-Ausschluss, Rabattabzug und Herausrechnung der Mehrwertsteuer, ausdrücklich vor bzw. ohne Retourenabzüge), und welcher prozentuale Anteil am gesamten Netto-Umsatz dieses Monats entfällt jeweils auf den Kanal?

# SQL

WITH channel_rev AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_id,
    ch.channel_name,
    SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.channels ch
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-01-31'
  GROUP BY ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name
)
SELECT
  channel_id,
  channel_name,
  net_revenue,
  net_revenue / SUM(net_revenue) OVER () AS pct_of_total
FROM channel_rev
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, channel_id ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz je Vertriebskanal im April 2025 (ohne Berücksichtigung von Retourenabzügen), und wie viel Prozent trug jeder Kanal zum gesamten Netto-Umsatz dieses Monats bei?

# SQL

WITH channel_rev AS (

    ch.channel_name,
    SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.channels ch
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'

  GROUP BY ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name
)
SELECT
  channel_id,
  channel_name,
  net_revenue,
  net_revenue / SUM(net_revenue) OVER () * 100 AS percentage_share
FROM channel_rev
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, channel_id ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz je Zahlungsmethode im Oktober 2025, ermittelt nach der internen Standarddefinition (unter Berücksichtigung von Rabatt und Mehrwertsteuer, ohne stornierte Bestellungen und ausdrücklich ohne Retourenabzüge), und wie hoch ist der prozentuale Anteil jeder Zahlungsmethode am gesamten Netto-Umsatz dieses Monats?

# SQL

WITH payment_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    o.payment_method,
    SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY o.payment_method
)
SELECT
  payment_method,
  ROUND(net_revenue, 2) AS net_revenue,
  ROUND(100.0 * net_revenue / SUM(net_revenue) OVER (), 2) AS revenue_share_pct
FROM payment_revenue
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, payment_method ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Kundenland im Januar 2025 im Vergleich zum Januar 2024? Berechne für beide Monate den Deckungsbeitrag unter Berücksichtigung von Netto-Umsatz, Einkaufskosten und Partnerprovisionen gemäß Glossar und gib das Land, den Wert für Januar 2024, den Wert für Januar 2025 sowie die absolute Differenz (Januar 2025 minus Januar 2024) aus.

# SQL

WITH monthly_cm AS (
  SELECT
    c.country_code,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS cm
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-01-31'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-01-31'
    )
  GROUP BY c.country_code, order_year
)
SELECT
  country_code,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN cm END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_2024_01,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN cm END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_2025_01,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN cm END), 0) - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN cm END), 0) AS differenz
FROM monthly_cm
GROUP BY country_code
ORDER BY country_code

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Kundenland im September 2025 im Vergleich zum September 2024 (jeweils unter Berücksichtigung von Netto-Umsatz, Einkaufskosten und Partnerprovision laut Glossar), und wie lautet die Differenz (2025 minus 2024)?

# SQL

WITH monthly_cm AS (
  SELECT
    c.country_code,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'
    )
  GROUP BY c.country_code, order_year
)
SELECT
  country_code,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_2024_09,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_2025_09,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0)
    - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS diff_deckungsbeitrag
FROM monthly_cm
GROUP BY country_code
ORDER BY country_code ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Kundenland im Dezember 2025 im Vergleich zum Dezember 2024? Berechne für jedes Land den Deckungsbeitrag für Dezember 2024, Dezember 2025 sowie die absolute Differenz (2025 minus 2024), sortiert nach dem Ländercode.

# SQL

WITH margin_per_country_month AS (
  SELECT
    c.country_code,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31')
      OR (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31')
    )
  GROUP BY c.country_code, order_year
)
SELECT
  country_code,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_2024_12,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_2025_12,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0)
    - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS diff_absolut
FROM margin_per_country_month
GROUP BY country_code
ORDER BY country_code ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Kundenland im Juni 2025 im Vergleich zum Juni 2024? Berechne Netto-Umsatz, Einkaufskosten und Partnerprovision strikt nach interner Definition und gib das Land, den Deckungsbeitrag für Juni 2024, den Deckungsbeitrag für Juni 2025 sowie die Differenz (Juni 2025 minus Juni 2024) aus, sortiert nach dem Land.

# SQL

WITH monthly_margin AS (
  SELECT
    c.country_code,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-06-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30')
      OR (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-06-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30')
    )
  GROUP BY c.country_code, order_year
)
SELECT
  country_code,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN contribution_margin END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_juni_2024,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN contribution_margin END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_juni_2025,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN contribution_margin END), 0)
    - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN contribution_margin END), 0) AS differenz
FROM monthly_margin
GROUP BY country_code
ORDER BY country_code ASC

    c.country_code,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END

  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Kundensegment im Februar 2025 im Vergleich zum Februar 2024? Berechne für beide Monate den Deckungsbeitrag sowie die absolute Differenz (Februar 2025 minus Februar 2024).

# SQL

WITH monthly_cm AS (
  SELECT
    c.segment,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-02-01' AND DATE '2024-02-29'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-01' AND DATE '2025-02-28'
    )
  GROUP BY c.segment, order_year
)
SELECT
  segment,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS deckungsbeitrag_2024_02,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS deckungsbeitrag_2025_02,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS diff_deckungsbeitrag
FROM monthly_cm
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment ASC

WITH monthly_cm AS (
  SELECT
    c.segment,

      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate

        END

  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Kundensegment im Oktober 2025 im Vergleich zum Oktober 2024, berechnet nach Hausdefinition mit Netto-Umsatz, Einkaufskosten und Partnerprovision? Gib je Kundensegment den Deckungsbeitrag für Oktober 2024, Oktober 2025 sowie die absolute Veränderung aus.

# SQL

WITH monthly_margins AS (
  SELECT
    c.segment,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-01' AND DATE '2024-10-31'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
    )
  GROUP BY c.segment, order_year
)
SELECT
  segment,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_okt_2024,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_okt_2025,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0)
    - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS differenz
FROM monthly_margins
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Vertriebskanal im Januar 2025 im Vergleich zum Januar 2024? Berechne für jeden Kanal den Deckungsbeitrag beider Monate sowie die absolute Differenz (Januar 2025 minus Januar 2024).

# SQL

WITH monthly_cm AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_id,
    ch.channel_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-01-31'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-01-31'
    )
  GROUP BY ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name, order_year
)
SELECT
  ch.channel_name,
  COALESCE(cm_2024.deckungsbeitrag, 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_2024_01,
  COALESCE(cm_2025.deckungsbeitrag, 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_2025_01,
  COALESCE(cm_2025.deckungsbeitrag, 0) - COALESCE(cm_2024.deckungsbeitrag, 0) AS diff_abs
FROM ecom_v1.channels ch
LEFT JOIN monthly_cm cm_2024
  ON ch.channel_id = cm_2024.channel_id
  AND cm_2024.order_year = 2024
LEFT JOIN monthly_cm cm_2025
  ON ch.channel_id = cm_2025.channel_id
  AND cm_2025.order_year = 2025
ORDER BY ch.channel_name ASC

# Question

Wende Netto-Umsatz, Einkaufskosten und Partnerprovision exakt nach Glossar an und sortiere das Ergebnis aufsteigend nach dem Namen des Vertriebskanals.

# SQL

WITH channel_margin AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_id,
    ch.channel_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-03-01' AND DATE '2024-03-31'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31'
    )
  GROUP BY ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name, order_year

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Vertriebskanal im Juni 2025 im Vergleich zum Juni 2024? Gib den Kanalnamen, den Deckungsbeitrag für Juni 2024, den Deckungsbeitrag für Juni 2025 sowie die absolute Differenz (Juni 2025 minus Juni 2024) aus, sortiert nach Vertriebskanal.

# SQL

WITH monthly_margin AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_id,
    ch.channel_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(
      ((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate))
      - (oi.quantity * p.purchase_price)
      - (CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-06-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-06-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
    )
  GROUP BY ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name, order_year
)
SELECT
  ch.channel_name,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN m.order_year = 2024 THEN m.deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_juni_2024,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN m.order_year = 2025 THEN m.deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_juni_2025,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN m.order_year = 2025 THEN m.deckungsbeitrag END), 0) - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN m.order_year = 2024 THEN m.deckungsbeitrag END), 0) AS differenz
FROM ecom_v1.channels ch
LEFT JOIN monthly_margin m ON ch.channel_id = m.channel_id
GROUP BY ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name
ORDER BY ch.channel_name ASC

WITH cm_per_channel_month AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_id,
    ch.channel_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS year_val,

      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.channels ch
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30')

# SQL

WITH monthly_margins AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_id,
    ch.channel_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-02-01' AND DATE '2024-02-29'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-01' AND DATE '2025-02-28'
    )
  GROUP BY ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name, order_year
)

  channel_name,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN contribution_margin END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_2024,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN contribution_margin END), 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_2025,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2025 THEN contribution_margin END), 0)
    - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN contribution_margin END), 0) AS differenz
FROM monthly_margins
GROUP BY channel_id, channel_name
ORDER BY channel_name ASC

WITH margin_by_period AS (

    o.payment_method,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(

      - CASE

# SQL

WITH monthly_cm AS (
  SELECT
    o.payment_method,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS yr,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-03-01' AND DATE '2024-03-31')
      OR (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-01' AND DATE '2025-03-31')

WITH monthly_margins AS (
  SELECT
    o.payment_method,

    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - (oi.quantity * p.purchase_price)
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END

  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-06-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-06-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
    )
  GROUP BY o.payment_method, yr_mo

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Zahlungsmethode im Februar 2025 im Vergleich zum Februar 2024? Berechne für beide Monate den exakten Deckungsbeitrag (Netto-Umsatz abzüglich Einkaufskosten und Partnerprovision) und gib je Zahlungsmethode den Wert für 2024, den Wert für 2025 sowie die absolute Differenz (2025 minus 2024) aus, sortiert nach der Zahlungsmethode.

# SQL

WITH monthly_margins AS (
  SELECT
    o.payment_method,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS yr,
    SUM(
      (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-02-01' AND DATE '2024-02-29')
      OR (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-01' AND DATE '2025-02-28')
    )
  GROUP BY o.payment_method, yr
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(m24.payment_method, m25.payment_method) AS payment_method,
  COALESCE(m24.deckungsbeitrag, 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_2024,
  COALESCE(m25.deckungsbeitrag, 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_2025,
  COALESCE(m25.deckungsbeitrag, 0) - COALESCE(m24.deckungsbeitrag, 0) AS diff_deckungsbeitrag
FROM (
  SELECT payment_method, deckungsbeitrag
  FROM monthly_margins
  WHERE yr = 2024
) m24
FULL OUTER JOIN (
  SELECT payment_method, deckungsbeitrag
  FROM monthly_margins
  WHERE yr = 2025
) m25 ON m24.payment_method = m25.payment_method
ORDER BY payment_method ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Deckungsbeitrag je Zahlungsmethode im Oktober 2025 im Vergleich zum Oktober 2024? Berechne für beide Monate den Deckungsbeitrag sowie die Differenz (Oktober 2025 minus Oktober 2024).

# SQL

WITH margin_by_month AS (
  SELECT
    o.payment_method,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(
      ((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate))
      - (oi.quantity * p.purchase_price)
      - (CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate ELSE 0 END)
    ) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-01' AND DATE '2024-10-31')
      OR (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31')
    )
  GROUP BY o.payment_method, order_year
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(m25.payment_method, m24.payment_method) AS payment_method,
  COALESCE(m24.deckungsbeitrag, 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_okt_2024,
  COALESCE(m25.deckungsbeitrag, 0) AS deckungsbeitrag_okt_2025,
  COALESCE(m25.deckungsbeitrag, 0) - COALESCE(m24.deckungsbeitrag, 0) AS differenz
FROM (SELECT * FROM margin_by_month WHERE order_year = 2025) m25
FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM margin_by_month WHERE order_year = 2024) m24
  ON m25.payment_method = m24.payment_method
ORDER BY payment_method

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz je Land im Januar 2024 (gemäß Definition vor Retourenabzügen), und wie hoch ist der jeweilige prozentuale Anteil am gesamten Netto-Umsatz dieses Monats?

# SQL

WITH revenue_per_country AS (
  SELECT
    c.country_code,
    SUM((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-01-31'
  GROUP BY c.country_code
)
SELECT
  country_code,
  net_revenue,
  ROUND(net_revenue / SUM(net_revenue) OVER () * 100, 2) AS revenue_share_pct
FROM revenue_per_country
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, country_code ASC;

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz nach Abzug von Retouren je Vertriebskanal im ersten Halbjahr 2024 verglichen mit dem ersten Halbjahr 2025? Bitte gib für jeden Kanal den Kanalnamen, den Netto-Umsatz H1 2024, den Netto-Umsatz H1 2025 sowie die absolute Differenz und die prozentuale Veränderung an, sortiert nach dem Kanalnamen.

# SQL

WITH item_level AS (
  SELECT
    o.channel_id,
    o.order_date,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate) AS line_net,
    COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0) AS line_refund
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
    FROM ecom_v1.returns
    GROUP BY order_item_id
  ) r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30')
      OR (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30')
    )
),
channel_periods AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN il.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30' THEN il.line_net - il.line_refund ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_h1_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN il.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN il.line_net - il.line_refund ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_h1_2025
  FROM ecom_v1.channels ch
  LEFT JOIN item_level il ON ch.channel_id = il.channel_id
  GROUP BY ch.channel_name
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  net_revenue_h1_2024,
  net_revenue_h1_2025,
  (net_revenue_h1_2025 - net_revenue_h1_2024) AS diff_abs,
  SAFE_DIVIDE((net_revenue_h1_2025 - net_revenue_h1_2024), net_revenue_h1_2024) * 100 AS change_pct
FROM channel_periods
ORDER BY channel_name ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz nach Abzug von Retouren je Vertriebskanal im ersten Halbjahr 2025 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2024? Gib den Kanalnamen, den Netto-Umsatz für H1 2024, für H1 2025, die absolute Differenz sowie die prozentuale Veränderung aus, sortiert nach dem Kanalnamen.

# SQL

WITH channel_item_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_name,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30' THEN 'H1_2024'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN 'H1_2025'
    END AS period,
    ((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate))
      - COALESCE(ret.total_refund, 0) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS total_refund
    FROM ecom_v1.returns
    GROUP BY order_item_id
  ) ret ON oi.order_item_id = ret.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
    )
),
period_totals AS (
  SELECT
    channel_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2024' THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_h1_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2025' THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_h1_2025
  FROM channel_item_revenue
  GROUP BY channel_name
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  net_revenue_h1_2024,
  net_revenue_h1_2025,
  (net_revenue_h1_2025 - net_revenue_h1_2024) AS diff_abs,
  ROUND((net_revenue_h1_2025 - net_revenue_h1_2024) / NULLIF(net_revenue_h1_2024, 0) * 100, 2) AS diff_pct
FROM period_totals
ORDER BY channel_name ASC

    oi.product_id,
    o.order_date,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate) AS net_revenue_before_returns,
    COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS total_refund
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30'

    )
  GROUP BY
    oi.order_item_id,
    oi.product_id,

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz nach Abzug von Retouren je Produktkategorie im ersten Halbjahr 2025 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2024? Gib den Kategorienamen, den Netto-Umsatz für H1 2024, den Netto-Umsatz für H1 2025 sowie die absolute Differenz und die prozentuale Veränderung aus, sortiert nach dem Netto-Umsatz in H1 2025 absteigend.

# SQL

WITH item_level AS (
  SELECT
    p.category_id,
    o.order_date,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate) - COALESCE(ret.total_refund, 0) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      order_item_id,
      SUM(refund_amount) AS total_refund
    FROM ecom_v1.returns
    GROUP BY order_item_id
  ) ret ON oi.order_item_id = ret.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
    )
),
period_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    c.category_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN il.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30' THEN il.net_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_h1_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN il.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN il.net_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_h1_2025
  FROM ecom_v1.categories c
  LEFT JOIN item_level il ON c.category_id = il.category_id
  GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
)

  category_name,
  net_revenue_h1_2024,
  net_revenue_h1_2025,
  (net_revenue_h1_2025 - net_revenue_h1_2024) AS diff_abs,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(net_revenue_h1_2025 - net_revenue_h1_2024, net_revenue_h1_2024) * 100 AS diff_pct
FROM period_metrics
ORDER BY net_revenue_h1_2025 DESC, category_name ASC

Bitte gib für jede Zahlungsmethode den Wert für H1 2024, den Wert für H1 2025, die absolute Differenz sowie die prozentuale Veränderung aus, sortiert nach der Zahlungsmethode.

# SQL

WITH item_returns AS (
  SELECT
    order_item_id,
    SUM(refund_amount) AS total_refund
  FROM ecom_v1.returns
  GROUP BY order_item_id
),
order_revenues AS (
  SELECT
    o.payment_method,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30' THEN 'H1_2024'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN 'H1_2025'
    END AS period,
    ((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) - COALESCE(r.total_refund, 0) AS line_net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  LEFT JOIN item_returns r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
    )
),
period_totals AS (
  SELECT
    payment_method,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2024' THEN line_net_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_h1_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2025' THEN line_net_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_h1_2025
  FROM order_revenues
  GROUP BY payment_method
)
SELECT
  payment_method,
  net_revenue_h1_2024,
  net_revenue_h1_2025,
  (net_revenue_h1_2025 - net_revenue_h1_2024) AS diff_abs,
  ROUND((net_revenue_h1_2025 - net_revenue_h1_2024) / NULLIF(net_revenue_h1_2024, 0) * 100, 2) AS pct_change
FROM period_totals
ORDER BY payment_method ASC

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz nach Abzug von Retouren je Kundenland im ersten Halbjahr 2025 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2024? Bitte gib das Land, den Netto-Umsatz H1 2024, den Netto-Umsatz H1 2025, die absolute Differenz sowie die prozentuale Veränderung aus, sortiert nach Land.

# SQL

WITH order_item_net AS (
  SELECT
    oi.order_item_id,
    c.country_code,
    o.order_date,
    ((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_amount), 0) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.returns r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30')
      OR (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30')
    )
  GROUP BY oi.order_item_id, c.country_code, o.order_date, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price_gross, oi.discount_amount, oi.tax_rate
),
country_periods AS (
  SELECT
    country_code,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30' THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_h1_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_h1_2025
  FROM order_item_net
  GROUP BY country_code
)
SELECT
  country_code,
  net_revenue_h1_2024,
  net_revenue_h1_2025,
  (net_revenue_h1_2025 - net_revenue_h1_2024) AS diff_abs,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(net_revenue_h1_2025 - net_revenue_h1_2024, net_revenue_h1_2024) * 100 AS pct_change
FROM country_periods
ORDER BY country_code ASC
