# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz nach Abzug von Retouren je Kundenland im ersten Halbjahr 2024 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2025? Gib das Kundenland, den Netto-Umsatz H1 2024, den Netto-Umsatz H1 2025 sowie die absolute Differenz und die prozentuale Veränderung aus, sortiert nach dem Land.

# SQL

WITH item_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    c.country_code,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30' THEN 'H1_2024'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN 'H1_2025'
    END AS period,
    ((oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate))
      - COALESCE(ret.refund_sum, 0) AS net_revenue_line
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      order_item_id,
      SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_sum
    FROM ecom_v1.returns
    GROUP BY order_item_id
  ) ret ON ret.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
    )
),
country_periods AS (
  SELECT
    country_code,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2024' THEN net_revenue_line ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_h1_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2025' THEN net_revenue_line ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_h1_2025
  FROM item_revenue
  GROUP BY country_code
)
SELECT
  country_code,
  net_revenue_h1_2024,
  net_revenue_h1_2025,
  net_revenue_h1_2025 - net_revenue_h1_2024 AS diff_absolute,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(net_revenue_h1_2025 - net_revenue_h1_2024, net_revenue_h1_2024) * 100 AS pct_change
FROM country_periods
ORDER BY country_code ASC

WITH item_level AS (
  SELECT
    c.segment,
    o.order_date,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate) AS line_net_revenue,
    COALESCE(r.total_refund, 0) AS line_refund
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      order_item_id,
      SUM(refund_amount) AS total_refund
    FROM ecom_v1.returns
    GROUP BY order_item_id
  ) r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
    )
),
segment_periods AS (
  SELECT
    segment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30' THEN line_net_revenue - line_refund ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_h1_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN line_net_revenue - line_refund ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_h1_2025
  FROM item_level
  GROUP BY segment
)
SELECT
  segment,

  net_revenue_h1_2025,

  SAFE_DIVIDE(net_revenue_h1_2025 - net_revenue_h1_2024, net_revenue_h1_2024) * 100 AS diff_pct

ORDER BY segment

# Question

Wie hoch war der Netto-Umsatz nach Abzug von Retouren je Hauptkategorie im ersten Halbjahr 2024 verglichen mit dem ersten Halbjahr 2025? Gib für jede Hauptkategorie den Netto-Umsatz 2024, den Netto-Umsatz 2025, die absolute Differenz (2025 minus 2024) sowie das prozentuale Wachstum aus.

# SQL

WITH item_level AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(parent.category_name, cat.category_name) AS main_category,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS yr,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - COALESCE(ret.total_refund, 0) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories cat
    ON p.category_id = cat.category_id
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories parent
    ON cat.parent_category_id = parent.category_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      order_item_id,
      SUM(refund_amount) AS total_refund
    FROM ecom_v1.returns
    GROUP BY order_item_id
  ) ret
    ON oi.order_item_id = ret.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
    )
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    main_category,
    SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2024 THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_h1_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2025 THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue_h1_2025
  FROM item_level
  GROUP BY main_category
)
SELECT
  main_category,
  net_revenue_h1_2024,
  net_revenue_h1_2025,
  (net_revenue_h1_2025 - net_revenue_h1_2024) AS diff_abs,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(net_revenue_h1_2025 - net_revenue_h1_2024, net_revenue_h1_2024) * 100 AS pct_change
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY main_category

WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-30' - INTERVAL 29 DAY AND DATE '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY anzahl_retouren DESC, hauptkategorie ASC

LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories p ON c.parent_category_id = p.category_id
WHERE cust.signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'

  AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
GROUP BY
  c.category_name
ORDER BY
  gesamt_bruttowert DESC,
  c.category_name ASC

ORDER BY order_status ASC;

SELECT
  COALESCE(parent.category_name, cat.category_name) AS hauptkategorie,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS anzahl_bestellungen,
  SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) AS bruttoumsatz
FROM ecom_v1.orders o
JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN ecom_v1.categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id
LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories parent ON cat.parent_category_id = parent.category_id
WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-03-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31'
  AND o.order_status != 'cancelled'
GROUP BY hauptkategorie
ORDER BY hauptkategorie ASC

# Question

Wie hoch ist der minimale Zahlungsbetrag pro Monat, berechnet aus der Summe von Bruttoartikelpreisen abzüglich Rabatten plus Versandkosten je Bestellung?

# SQL

WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS order_month,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) + o.shipping_cost AS total_amount
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id, order_month, o.shipping_cost
)
SELECT
  order_month,
  MIN(total_amount) AS min_payment
FROM order_totals
GROUP BY order_month
ORDER BY order_month ASC

# Question

Wie viele Bestellungen, wie viele Bestellpositionen im Durchschnitt je Bestellung und welche Gesamtmenge an Artikeln wurden jeweils pro Hauptkategorie verzeichnet?

# SQL

SELECT
  COALESCE(parent.category_name, cat.category_name) AS main_category_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS order_count,
  COUNT(oi.order_item_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS avg_items_per_order,
  SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN ecom_v1.categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id
LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories parent ON cat.parent_category_id = parent.category_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC, main_category_name ASC

# Question

Wie viele Bestellungen, wie viele Bestellpositionen im Durchschnitt pro Bestellung und welche Gesamtmenge an Artikeln gibt es jeweils gruppiert nach dem Bestellstatus?

# SQL

WITH order_aggregates AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.order_status,
    COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_count,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_status
)
SELECT
  order_status,
  COUNT(order_id) AS order_count,
  AVG(item_count) AS avg_items_per_order,
  SUM(total_quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM order_aggregates
GROUP BY order_status
ORDER BY order_status ASC;

# Question

Wie viele Bestellungen, wie viele Bestellpositionen im Durchschnitt pro Bestellung und welche Gesamtmenge an Artikeln wurden jeweils pro Hauptkategorie verzeichnet? Gib den Namen der Hauptkategorie an und sortiere das Ergebnis alphabetisch danach.

# SQL

WITH item_main_cat AS (
  SELECT
    oi.order_id,
    oi.order_item_id,
    oi.quantity,
    COALESCE(parent.category_name, cat.category_name) AS main_category_name
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories parent ON cat.parent_category_id = parent.category_id
),
order_summary AS (
  SELECT
    main_category_name,
    order_id,
    COUNT(order_item_id) AS items_in_order,
    SUM(quantity) AS quantity_in_order
  FROM item_main_cat
  GROUP BY main_category_name, order_id
)
SELECT
  main_category_name,
  COUNT(order_id) AS anzahl_bestellungen,
  AVG(items_in_order) AS avg_positionen_pro_bestellung,
  SUM(quantity_in_order) AS summe_menge
FROM order_summary
GROUP BY main_category_name
ORDER BY main_category_name ASC;

Wie viele Bestellungen gibt es je Bestellstatus, wie viele Bestellpositionen umfasst eine Bestellung dabei im Durchschnitt und wie hoch ist die Gesamtsumme der bestellten Mengen?

# SQL

WITH order_stats AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.order_status,
    COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_count,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity

  COUNT(order_id) AS order_count,
  AVG(item_count) AS avg_items_per_order,
  SUM(total_quantity) AS sum_quantity
FROM order_stats
GROUP BY order_status
ORDER BY order_status

FROM ecom_v1.customers c

GROUP BY c.segment
ORDER BY c.segment ASC

# Question

Wie viele Bestellungen, wie viele Bestellpositionen im Durchschnitt pro Bestellung und welche Gesamtmenge an Artikeln gab es jeweils pro Hauptkategorie?

# SQL

WITH item_level AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(parent.category_name, cat.category_name) AS main_category_name,
    oi.order_id,
    oi.order_item_id,
    oi.quantity
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories parent ON cat.parent_category_id = parent.category_id
),
per_order_category AS (
  SELECT
    main_category_name,
    order_id,
    COUNT(order_item_id) AS items_in_order,
    SUM(quantity) AS order_quantity
  FROM item_level
  GROUP BY main_category_name, order_id
)
SELECT
  main_category_name,
  COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders,
  ROUND(AVG(items_in_order), 2) AS avg_items_per_order,
  SUM(order_quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM per_order_category
GROUP BY main_category_name
ORDER BY main_category_name ASC

# Question

Wie viele Bestellungen gab es jeweils pro Zahlungsmethode, wie viele Bestellpositionen hatte eine Bestellung dabei im Durchschnitt und wie hoch ist die Gesamtsumme der bestellten Mengen?

# SQL

WITH order_stats AS (
  SELECT
    o.payment_method,
    o.order_id,
    COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_count,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_qty
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY o.payment_method, o.order_id
)
SELECT
  payment_method,
  COUNT(order_id) AS order_count,
  AVG(item_count) AS avg_items_per_order,
  SUM(total_qty) AS sum_quantity
FROM order_stats
GROUP BY payment_method
ORDER BY payment_method ASC

# SQL

SELECT

  COUNT(DISTINCT r.customer_id) AS repeat_customers
FROM (

    customer_id,
    channel_id
  FROM ecom_v1.orders
  WHERE order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY customer_id, channel_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', order_date)) >= 2
) r
JOIN ecom_v1.channels c ON c.channel_id = r.channel_id
GROUP BY c.channel_name
ORDER BY repeat_customers DESC, c.channel_name ASC

GROUP BY c.country_code
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC, c.country_code ASC

# Question

SELECT

  COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS repeat_customers
FROM ecom_v1.channels ch

WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-12-31'

    SELECT customer_id
    FROM ecom_v1.orders
    WHERE order_status != 'cancelled'

    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', order_date)) >= 2
  )
GROUP BY ch.channel_name
ORDER BY repeat_customers DESC, ch.channel_name ASC

Wie viele Wiederkäufer gab es im Kalenderjahr 2026 je Vertriebskanal? Gib den Kanalnamen und die Anzahl der Wiederkäufer aus, sortiert nach der Anzahl absteigend, bei Gleichstand alphabetisch nach Kanalname.

# SQL

WITH repeat_customers_per_channel AS (
  SELECT
    o.channel_id,
    o.customer_id
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-12-31'
  GROUP BY o.channel_id, o.customer_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', o.order_date)) >= 2
)
SELECT
  c.channel_name,
  COUNT(rc.customer_id) AS repeat_customer_count
FROM ecom_v1.channels c
LEFT JOIN repeat_customers_per_channel rc
  ON c.channel_id = rc.channel_id
GROUP BY c.channel_id, c.channel_name
ORDER BY repeat_customer_count DESC, c.channel_name ASC

# Question

Wie hoch ist der Deckungsbeitrag je Hauptkategorie im ersten Halbjahr 2026 unter Berücksichtigung von Einkaufspreisen, Provisionen, Rabatten, Steuern und Stornos gemäß Glossar?

# SQL

SELECT
  COALESCE(parent.category_name, cat.category_name) AS main_category_name,
  ROUND(SUM(
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
    - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
    - CASE
        WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
        ELSE 0
      END
  ), 2) AS deckungsbeitrag
FROM ecom_v1.orders o
JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN ecom_v1.categories cat ON p.category_id = cat.category_id
LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories parent ON cat.parent_category_id = parent.category_id
JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON o.channel_id = ch.channel_id
WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY deckungsbeitrag DESC, main_category_name ASC

# Question

Wie viele Bestellungen und welcher Bruttowarenwert (Summe aus Menge mal Bruttostückpreis abzüglich Rabatt) wurden je Land im ersten Halbjahr 2026 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2025 erzielt? Gib für jedes Land die Anzahl der Bestellungen und den Bruttowarenwert beider Halbjahre, die jeweilige absolute Differenz sowie die prozentuale Veränderung an.

# SQL

WITH period_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    c.country_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN o.order_id END) AS orders_h1_2025,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN o.order_id END) AS orders_h1_2026,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) ELSE 0 END) AS gross_sales_h1_2025,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) ELSE 0 END) AS gross_sales_h1_2026
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30')
  GROUP BY c.country_code
)
SELECT
  country_code,
  orders_h1_2025,
  orders_h1_2026,
  (orders_h1_2026 - orders_h1_2025) AS diff_orders,
  ROUND((orders_h1_2026 - orders_h1_2025) * 100.0 / NULLIF(orders_h1_2025, 0), 2) AS pct_change_orders,
  gross_sales_h1_2025,
  gross_sales_h1_2026,
  (gross_sales_h1_2026 - gross_sales_h1_2025) AS diff_gross_sales,
  ROUND((gross_sales_h1_2026 - gross_sales_h1_2025) * 100.0 / NULLIF(gross_sales_h1_2025, 0), 2) AS pct_change_gross_sales
FROM period_metrics
ORDER BY country_code ASC

# Question

Wie viele Bestellungen und welcher Bruttoumsatz (definiert als Summe aus Menge mal Bruttoeinzelpreis abzüglich Rabatt) wurden je Vertriebskanal im ersten Halbjahr 2026 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2025 erzielt? Gib für jeden Kanal den Kanalnamen, die Bestellanzahl und den Umsatz beider Halbjahre sowie die jeweilige absolute Differenz und prozentuale Veränderung von 2025 auf 2026 an, sortiert nach Kanalname.

# SQL

WITH period_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.channel_id,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN 'h1_2025'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN 'h1_2026'
    END AS period,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) AS order_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
     OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30')
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.channel_id, period
),
channel_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    c.channel_id,
    c.channel_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN po.period = 'h1_2025' THEN po.order_id END) AS orders_h1_2025,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN po.period = 'h1_2026' THEN po.order_id END) AS orders_h1_2026,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN po.period = 'h1_2025' THEN po.order_revenue END), 0) AS revenue_h1_2025,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN po.period = 'h1_2026' THEN po.order_revenue END), 0) AS revenue_h1_2026
  FROM ecom_v1.channels c
  LEFT JOIN period_orders po ON c.channel_id = po.channel_id
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, c.channel_name
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  orders_h1_2025,
  orders_h1_2026,
  (orders_h1_2026 - orders_h1_2025) AS diff_orders,
  ROUND(IEEE_DIVIDE(CAST(orders_h1_2026 - orders_h1_2025 AS NUMERIC), orders_h1_2025) * 100, 2) AS pct_change_orders,
  revenue_h1_2025,
  revenue_h1_2026,
  (revenue_h1_2026 - revenue_h1_2025) AS diff_revenue,
  ROUND(IEEE_DIVIDE(revenue_h1_2026 - revenue_h1_2025, revenue_h1_2025) * 100, 2) AS pct_change_revenue
FROM channel_metrics
ORDER BY channel_name ASC

Gib das Kundensegment, die Bestellanzahl und den Umsatz für H1 2025 und H1 2026 sowie die absolute Differenz und die prozentuale Veränderung von 2025 auf 2026 für beide Kennzahlen an, sortiert nach Kundensegment.

# SQL

WITH period_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    c.segment,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN 'H1_2025'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN 'H1_2026'
    END AS period,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) AS revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30')

    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2026' THEN order_count ELSE 0 END) AS orders_h1_2026,

# Question

Wie viele Bestellungen und welcher Bruttoumsatz (definiert als Summe aus Menge mal Bruttoeinzelpreis abzüglich Rabatt, ohne Abzug von Stornierungen) wurden je Hauptkategorie im Zeitraum 2026-01-01 bis 2026-06-30 im Vergleich zum Zeitraum 2025-01-01 bis 2025-06-30 erzielt? Gib den Namen der Hauptkategorie, die Anzahl der Bestellungen und den Bruttoumsatz für H1 2025 und H1 2026 sowie die jeweilige absolute Differenz (2026 minus 2025) und prozentuale Veränderung aus, sortiert nach dem Namen der Hauptkategorie.

# SQL

WITH cat_mapping AS (
  SELECT
    c.category_id,
    COALESCE(p.category_name, c.category_name) AS main_category_name
  FROM ecom_v1.categories c
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories p
    ON c.parent_category_id = p.category_id
),
period_data AS (
  SELECT
    cm.main_category_name,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN '2025_H1'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN '2026_H1'
    END AS period,
    o.order_id,
    oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount AS item_gross_sales
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products pr
    ON oi.product_id = pr.product_id
  JOIN cat_mapping cm
    ON pr.category_id = cm.category_id
  WHERE (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30')
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    main_category_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN period = '2025_H1' THEN order_id END) AS orders_2025,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN period = '2026_H1' THEN order_id END) AS orders_2026,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2025_H1' THEN item_gross_sales END), 0) AS sales_2025,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026_H1' THEN item_gross_sales END), 0) AS sales_2026
  FROM period_data
  GROUP BY main_category_name
)
SELECT
  main_category_name,
  orders_2025,
  orders_2026,
  orders_2026 - orders_2025 AS diff_orders,
  ROUND((orders_2026 - orders_2025) * 100.0 / NULLIF(orders_2025, 0), 2) AS pct_change_orders,
  sales_2025,
  sales_2026,
  sales_2026 - sales_2025 AS diff_sales,
  ROUND((sales_2026 - sales_2025) * 100.0 / NULLIF(sales_2025, 0), 2) AS pct_change_sales
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY main_category_name ASC;

# Question

Wie viele Bestellungen und welcher Gesamtumsatz (berechnet rein als Summe aus Menge mal Brutto-Einzelpreis abzüglich Rabatt) wurden je Produktmarke bzw. Herstellername – ermittelt als erstes Wort des Produktnamens – im ersten Halbjahr 2026 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2025 erzielt? Gib für jede Marke die Bestellanzahl und den Umsatz beider Halbjahre, die absolute Differenz sowie die prozentuale Veränderung von 2025 auf 2026 an, sortiert nach dem Umsatz im ersten Halbjahr 2026 absteigend.

# SQL

WITH brand_sales AS (
  SELECT
    SPLIT(p.product_name, ' ')[OFFSET(0)] AS brand,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN 'H1_2025'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN 'H1_2026'
    END AS period,
    o.order_id,
    oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount AS item_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30')
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    brand,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2025' THEN order_id END) AS order_count_h1_2025,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2025' THEN item_revenue END), 0) AS revenue_h1_2025,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2026' THEN order_id END) AS order_count_h1_2026,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2026' THEN item_revenue END), 0) AS revenue_h1_2026
  FROM brand_sales
  GROUP BY brand
)
SELECT
  brand,
  order_count_h1_2025,
  order_count_h1_2026,
  order_count_h1_2026 - order_count_h1_2025 AS order_count_diff,
  ROUND(IEEE_DIVIDE(CAST(order_count_h1_2026 - order_count_h1_2025 AS NUMERIC), order_count_h1_2025) * 100, 2) AS order_count_pct_change,
  revenue_h1_2025,
  revenue_h1_2026,
  revenue_h1_2026 - revenue_h1_2025 AS revenue_diff,
  ROUND(IEEE_DIVIDE(revenue_h1_2026 - revenue_h1_2025, revenue_h1_2025) * 100, 2) AS revenue_pct_change
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY revenue_h1_2026 DESC, brand ASC

WITH period_data AS (
  SELECT
    o.payment_method,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN 'H1_2025'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN 'H1_2026'
    END AS period,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) AS revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id

  GROUP BY o.payment_method, period
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT

    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2025' THEN order_count END), 0) AS orders_h1_2025,

# Question

Wie viele Bestellungen und wie viel Umsatz (berechnet als Summe aus Menge multipliziert mit dem Brutto-Einzelpreis abzüglich Rabatt) wurden je Kundenland im ersten Halbjahr 2026 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2025 erzielt? Gib für jedes Land die Bestellanzahl und den Umsatz beider Halbjahre, die absolute Differenz sowie die prozentuale Veränderung aus (sortiert nach Land).

# SQL

WITH metrics_per_period AS (
  SELECT
    c.country_code,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN 'H1_2025'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN 'H1_2026'
    END AS period,
    o.order_id,
    oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount AS item_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
     OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30')
),
aggregated AS (
  SELECT
    country_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2025' THEN order_id END) AS orders_h1_2025,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2026' THEN order_id END) AS orders_h1_2026,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2025' THEN item_revenue END), 0) AS revenue_h1_2025,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2026' THEN item_revenue END), 0) AS revenue_h1_2026
  FROM metrics_per_period
  GROUP BY country_code
)
SELECT
  country_code,
  orders_h1_2025,
  orders_h1_2026,
  orders_h1_2026 - orders_h1_2025 AS diff_orders,
  ROUND((orders_h1_2026 - orders_h1_2025) / NULLIF(orders_h1_2025, 0) * 100, 2) AS pct_change_orders,
  revenue_h1_2025,
  revenue_h1_2026,
  revenue_h1_2026 - revenue_h1_2025 AS diff_revenue,
  ROUND((revenue_h1_2026 - revenue_h1_2025) / NULLIF(revenue_h1_2025, 0) * 100, 2) AS pct_change_revenue
FROM aggregated
ORDER BY country_code ASC

Gib für jeden Kanal den Kanalnamen, die Bestellanzahl und den Bruttoumsatz für H1 2025 und H1 2026 sowie jeweils die absolute Differenz und die prozentuale Veränderung von H1 2025 auf H1 2026 an, sortiert nach dem Kanalnamen.

WITH channel_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.channel_id,
    o.order_date,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross) AS order_gross_sales
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30')
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.channel_id, o.order_date
),
period_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    channel_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN order_id END) AS orders_h1_2025,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN order_id END) AS orders_h1_2026,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN order_gross_sales END), 0) AS gross_sales_h1_2025,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN order_gross_sales END), 0) AS gross_sales_h1_2026
  FROM channel_orders
  GROUP BY channel_id
)
SELECT
  ch.channel_name,
  pm.orders_h1_2025,
  pm.orders_h1_2026,
  pm.orders_h1_2026 - pm.orders_h1_2025 AS orders_diff,
  ROUND((pm.orders_h1_2026 - pm.orders_h1_2025) * 100.0 / NULLIF(pm.orders_h1_2025, 0), 2) AS orders_pct_change,
  pm.gross_sales_h1_2025,
  pm.gross_sales_h1_2026,
  pm.gross_sales_h1_2026 - pm.gross_sales_h1_2025 AS gross_sales_diff,
  ROUND((pm.gross_sales_h1_2026 - pm.gross_sales_h1_2025) * 100.0 / NULLIF(pm.gross_sales_h1_2025, 0), 2) AS gross_sales_pct_change
FROM ecom_v1.channels ch
LEFT JOIN period_metrics pm ON ch.channel_id = pm.channel_id
ORDER BY ch.channel_name ASC

  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id

# Question

Wie viele Bestellungen und welcher Bruttoumsatz (Menge mal tatsächlich berechneter Stückpreis abzüglich Rabatt) wurden je Hauptkategorie im ersten Halbjahr 2026 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2025 erzielt? Gib für jede Hauptkategorie die Anzahl der Bestellungen sowie den Bruttoumsatz für H1 2025 und H1 2026, die absolute Differenz (2026 minus 2025) und die prozentuale Veränderung an, sortiert nach dem Bruttoumsatz 2026 absteigend.

# SQL

WITH cat_tree AS (
  SELECT
    c.category_id,
    COALESCE(p.category_name, c.category_name) AS main_category_name
  FROM ecom_v1.categories c
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories p ON c.parent_category_id = p.category_id
),
order_cat_base AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    ct.main_category_name,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN '2025_H1'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN '2026_H1'
    END AS period,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) AS item_gross_rev
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products pr ON oi.product_id = pr.product_id
  JOIN cat_tree ct ON pr.category_id = ct.category_id
  WHERE (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30')
  GROUP BY o.order_id, ct.main_category_name, period
),
period_agg AS (
  SELECT
    main_category_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN period = '2025_H1' THEN order_id END) AS orders_2025_h1,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2025_H1' THEN item_gross_rev END), 0) AS revenue_2025_h1,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN period = '2026_H1' THEN order_id END) AS orders_2026_h1,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period = '2026_H1' THEN item_gross_rev END), 0) AS revenue_2026_h1
  FROM order_cat_base
  GROUP BY main_category_name
)
SELECT
  main_category_name,
  orders_2025_h1,
  orders_2026_h1,
  orders_2026_h1 - orders_2025_h1 AS orders_diff,
  ROUND(IEEE_DIVIDE((orders_2026_h1 - orders_2025_h1) * 100.0, NULLIF(orders_2025_h1, 0)), 2) AS orders_pct_change,
  revenue_2025_h1,
  revenue_2026_h1,
  revenue_2026_h1 - revenue_2025_h1 AS revenue_diff,
  ROUND(IEEE_DIVIDE((revenue_2026_h1 - revenue_2025_h1) * 100.0, NULLIF(revenue_2025_h1, 0)), 2) AS revenue_pct_change
FROM period_agg
ORDER BY revenue_2026_h1 DESC, main_category_name ASC

# Question

Berechne für jede Kategorie den Vergleich zwischen dem ersten Halbjahr 2025 (2025-01-01 bis 2025-06-30) und dem ersten Halbjahr 2026 (2026-01-01 bis 2026-06-30): Wie hoch sind jeweils die Anzahl der unterschiedlichen Bestellungen und die Summe der tatsächlichen Artikelumsätze (Menge mal Brutto-Einzelpreis abzüglich Rabatt)? Gib für beide Halbjahre die Bestellanzahl und die Summe der Artikelumsätze sowie jeweils die absolute Differenz (H1 2026 minus H1 2025) und die prozentuale Veränderung aus, sortiert nach Kategorie-ID.

# SQL

WITH period_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    p.category_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN o.order_id END) AS orders_h1_2025,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN o.order_id END) AS orders_h1_2026,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_h1_2025,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_h1_2026
  FROM ecom_v1.categories c
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
     OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30')
  GROUP BY p.category_id
)
SELECT
  c.category_id,
  c.category_name,
  pm.orders_h1_2025,
  pm.orders_h1_2026,
  pm.orders_h1_2026 - pm.orders_h1_2025 AS diff_orders,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(pm.orders_h1_2026 - pm.orders_h1_2025, pm.orders_h1_2025) * 100, 2) AS pct_change_orders,
  pm.revenue_h1_2025,
  pm.revenue_h1_2026,
  pm.revenue_h1_2026 - pm.revenue_h1_2025 AS diff_revenue,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(pm.revenue_h1_2026 - pm.revenue_h1_2025, pm.revenue_h1_2025) * 100, 2) AS pct_change_revenue
FROM period_metrics pm
JOIN ecom_v1.categories c ON pm.category_id = c.category_id
ORDER BY c.category_id ASC

# Question

Vergleiche für jede Zahlungsmethode die Anzahl der Bestellungen sowie die Summe aus Menge mal Bruttostückpreis abzüglich Rabatt zwischen dem ersten Halbjahr 2025 (01.01.2025 bis 30.06.2025) und dem ersten Halbjahr 2026 (01.01.2026 bis 30.06.2026). Gib je Zahlungsmethode die Bestellanzahl und den Umsatz beider Halbjahre, die jeweilige absolute Differenz (2026 minus 2025) sowie die prozentuale Veränderung aus und sortiere nach der Zahlungsmethode.

# SQL

WITH metrics_by_period AS (
  SELECT
    o.payment_method,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN o.order_id END) AS orders_h1_2025,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount END), 0) AS revenue_h1_2025,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN o.order_id END) AS orders_h1_2026,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount END), 0) AS revenue_h1_2026
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30')
  GROUP BY o.payment_method
)

  payment_method,
  orders_h1_2025,
  orders_h1_2026,
  orders_h1_2026 - orders_h1_2025 AS orders_diff,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(orders_h1_2026 - orders_h1_2025, orders_h1_2025) * 100, 2) AS orders_pct_change,
  revenue_h1_2025,
  revenue_h1_2026,

  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(revenue_h1_2026 - revenue_h1_2025, revenue_h1_2025) * 100, 2) AS revenue_pct_change
FROM metrics_by_period
ORDER BY payment_method ASC

# Question

Vergleiche die Anzahl der Bestellungen sowie die Summe der tatsächlichen Bruttoerlöse (Menge mal Bruttoeinzelpreis abzüglich Rabatt) je Vertriebskanal zwischen dem ersten Halbjahr 2025 (2025-01-01 bis 2025-06-30) und dem ersten Halbjahr 2026 (2026-01-01 bis 2026-06-30) für alle nicht stornierten Bestellungen. Gib den Kanalnamen, die Bestellanzahl H1 2025, die Bestellanzahl H1 2026, deren absolute Differenz und prozentuale Veränderung sowie den Umsatz H1 2025, den Umsatz H1 2026, deren absolute Differenz und prozentuale Veränderung aus, sortiert nach dem Kanalnamen.

# SQL

WITH channel_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.channel_id,
    o.order_date,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) AS order_gross_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30')
      OR (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30')
    )
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.channel_id, o.order_date
),
channel_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    c.channel_id,
    c.channel_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN co.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN co.order_id END) AS orders_h1_2025,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN co.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN co.order_id END) AS orders_h1_2026,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN co.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN co.order_gross_revenue END), 0) AS revenue_h1_2025,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN co.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN co.order_gross_revenue END), 0) AS revenue_h1_2026
  FROM ecom_v1.channels c
  LEFT JOIN channel_orders co ON c.channel_id = co.channel_id
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, c.channel_name
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  orders_h1_2025,
  orders_h1_2026,
  (orders_h1_2026 - orders_h1_2025) AS orders_diff,
  CASE
    WHEN orders_h1_2025 = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ((orders_h1_2026 - orders_h1_2025) / CAST(orders_h1_2025 AS NUMERIC)) * 100
  END AS orders_pct_change,
  revenue_h1_2025,
  revenue_h1_2026,
  (revenue_h1_2026 - revenue_h1_2025) AS revenue_diff,
  CASE
    WHEN revenue_h1_2025 = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ((revenue_h1_2026 - revenue_h1_2025) / revenue_h1_2025) * 100
  END AS revenue_pct_change
FROM channel_metrics
ORDER BY channel_name ASC

# Question

Vergleiche für jedes Kundensegment die Anzahl an Bestellungen sowie den Brutto-Umsatz (Menge mal tatsächlicher Einzelpreis abzüglich Rabatt) im ersten Halbjahr 2026 (01.01.2026 bis 30.06.2026) mit dem ersten Halbjahr 2025 (01.01.2025 bis 30.06.2025), ohne stornierte Bestellungen zu berücksichtigen. Gib je Segment die Bestellanzahl und den Brutto-Umsatz für H1 2025 und H1 2026, die jeweiligen absoluten Differenzen (H1 2026 minus H1 2025) sowie die prozentualen Veränderungen aus, sortiert nach Kundensegment.

# SQL

WITH period_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    c.segment,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN 'H1_2025'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN 'H1_2026'
    END AS period,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) AS revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
    )
  GROUP BY c.segment, period
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    segment,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2025' THEN order_count ELSE 0 END) AS orders_h1_2025,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2026' THEN order_count ELSE 0 END) AS orders_h1_2026,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2025' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_h1_2025,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2026' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_h1_2026
  FROM period_metrics
  GROUP BY segment
)
SELECT
  segment,
  orders_h1_2025,
  orders_h1_2026,
  orders_h1_2026 - orders_h1_2025 AS diff_orders,
  ROUND((orders_h1_2026 - orders_h1_2025) / NULLIF(orders_h1_2025, 0) * 100, 2) AS pct_change_orders,
  revenue_h1_2025,
  revenue_h1_2026,
  revenue_h1_2026 - revenue_h1_2025 AS diff_revenue,
  ROUND((revenue_h1_2026 - revenue_h1_2025) / NULLIF(revenue_h1_2025, 0) * 100, 2) AS pct_change_revenue
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY segment ASC

# Question

Vergleiche für jede Hauptkategorie die Anzahl der Bestellungen sowie den Bruttoumsatz (Summe aus Anzahl mal Bruttoeinzelpreis abzüglich Rabattbetrag, ohne stornierte Bestellungen) zwischen dem ersten Halbjahr 2025 (01.01.2025 bis 30.06.2025) und dem ersten Halbjahr 2026 (01.01.2026 bis 30.06.2026). Gib für jede Hauptkategorie den Kategorienamen, die Bestellanzahl H1 2025, die Bestellanzahl H1 2026, die absolute Differenz der Bestellungen (2026 minus 2025), die prozentuale Veränderung der Bestellungen, den Bruttoumsatz H1 2025, den Bruttoumsatz H1 2026, die absolute Differenz des Bruttoumsatzes (2026 minus 2025) sowie die prozentuale Veränderung des Bruttoumsatzes aus. Sortiere das Ergebnis aufsteigend nach dem Namen der Hauptkategorie.

# SQL

WITH main_categories AS (
  SELECT
    c.category_id,
    COALESCE(parent.category_name, c.category_name) AS main_category_name
  FROM ecom_v1.categories c
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories parent
    ON c.parent_category_id = parent.category_id
),
order_category_agg AS (
  SELECT
    mc.main_category_name,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN '2025_H1'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN '2026_H1'
    END AS period,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) AS total_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN main_categories mc
    ON p.category_id = mc.category_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
    )
  GROUP BY mc.main_category_name, period
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    main_category_name,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN period = '2025_H1' THEN order_count END), 0) AS orders_h1_2025,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN period = '2026_H1' THEN order_count END), 0) AS orders_h1_2026,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN period = '2025_H1' THEN total_revenue END), 0) AS revenue_h1_2025,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN period = '2026_H1' THEN total_revenue END), 0) AS revenue_h1_2026
  FROM order_category_agg
  GROUP BY main_category_name
)
SELECT
  main_category_name,
  orders_h1_2025,
  orders_h1_2026,
  orders_h1_2026 - orders_h1_2025 AS diff_orders,
  SAFE_DIVIDE((orders_h1_2026 - orders_h1_2025) * 100.0, orders_h1_2025) AS pct_change_orders,
  revenue_h1_2025,
  revenue_h1_2026,
  revenue_h1_2026 - revenue_h1_2025 AS diff_revenue,
  SAFE_DIVIDE((revenue_h1_2026 - revenue_h1_2025) * 100.0, revenue_h1_2025) AS pct_change_revenue
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY main_category_name ASC

# Question

Berechne für jede Kategorie den Vergleich zwischen dem ersten Halbjahr 2026 (2026-01-01 bis 2026-06-30) und dem ersten Halbjahr 2025 (2025-01-01 bis 2025-06-30): Wie hoch waren jeweils die Anzahl der Bestellpositionen sowie der reine Bruttoumsatz (definiert als Summe aus Menge mal Bruttoeinzelpreis)? Gib den Kategorienamen, die Bestellpositionsanzahl und den Bruttoumsatz für H1 2025 und H1 2026, die jeweilige Differenz (H1 2026 minus H1 2025) sowie die prozentuale Veränderung des Bruttoumsatzes aus. Sortiere das Ergebnis absteigend nach dem Bruttoumsatz im ersten Halbjahr 2026.

# SQL

WITH h1_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    c.category_id,
    c.category_name,
    COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS order_items_count_2025,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross) AS gross_revenue_2025
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
  WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
  GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
),
h1_2026 AS (
  SELECT
    c.category_id,
    c.category_name,
    COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS order_items_count_2026,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross) AS gross_revenue_2026
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
  WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(t26.category_name, t25.category_name) AS category_name,
  COALESCE(t25.order_items_count_2025, 0) AS order_items_count_h1_2025,
  COALESCE(t26.order_items_count_2026, 0) AS order_items_count_h1_2026,
  COALESCE(t26.order_items_count_2026, 0) - COALESCE(t25.order_items_count_2025, 0) AS diff_order_items_count,
  COALESCE(t25.gross_revenue_2025, 0) AS gross_revenue_h1_2025,
  COALESCE(t26.gross_revenue_2026, 0) AS gross_revenue_h1_2026,
  COALESCE(t26.gross_revenue_2026, 0) - COALESCE(t25.gross_revenue_2025, 0) AS diff_gross_revenue,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(t25.gross_revenue_2025, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE ((COALESCE(t26.gross_revenue_2026, 0) - COALESCE(t25.gross_revenue_2025, 0)) / t25.gross_revenue_2025) * 100
  END AS pct_change_gross_revenue
FROM h1_2026 t26
FULL OUTER JOIN h1_2025 t25 ON t26.category_id = t25.category_id
ORDER BY gross_revenue_h1_2026 DESC, category_name ASC

# Question

Wie entwickelten sich die Anzahl der Bestellungen und die Summe aus Menge mal Bruttostückpreis abzüglich Rabatt je Zahlungsmethode im ersten Halbjahr 2026 im Vergleich zum ersten Halbjahr 2025? Gib für jede Zahlungsmethode die Bestellanzahl und den Umsatz beider Halbjahre, die absolute Differenz sowie die prozentuale Veränderung an.

# SQL

WITH order_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.payment_method,
    o.order_date,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) AS order_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE (o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30')
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.payment_method, o.order_date
),
period_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    payment_method,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN order_id END) AS orders_h1_2025,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN order_id END) AS orders_h1_2026,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN order_revenue END), 0) AS revenue_h1_2025,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN order_revenue END), 0) AS revenue_h1_2026
  FROM order_metrics
  GROUP BY payment_method
)
SELECT
  payment_method,
  orders_h1_2025,
  orders_h1_2026,
  orders_h1_2026 - orders_h1_2025 AS diff_orders,
  ROUND((orders_h1_2026 - orders_h1_2025) / NULLIF(orders_h1_2025, 0) * 100, 2) AS pct_change_orders,
  revenue_h1_2025,
  revenue_h1_2026,
  revenue_h1_2026 - revenue_h1_2025 AS diff_revenue,
  ROUND((revenue_h1_2026 - revenue_h1_2025) / NULLIF(revenue_h1_2025, 0) * 100, 2) AS pct_change_revenue
FROM period_metrics
ORDER BY payment_method ASC

# Question

Wie viele Bestellungen entfallen auf die einzelnen übergeordneten Kategorien und wie hoch ist der jeweilige Anteil an allen Bestellungen?

# SQL

# Question

Welche Kunden waren laut unserer Definition eines Aktiven Kunden am Stichtag 2026-03-31 aktiv, am Stichtag 2026-06-30 aber nicht mehr? Wende an beiden Stichtagen die volle 90-Tage-Regel für nicht stornierte Bestellungen und die Regel nicht gelöschter Konten an. Gib customer_id und customer_number aus, sortiert nach customer_id.

# SQL

WITH active_20260331 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.customer_number
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-03-31', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-03-31'
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
),
active_20260630 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-06-30'
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
)
SELECT a.customer_id, a.customer_number
FROM active_20260331 a
LEFT JOIN active_20260630 b ON a.customer_id = b.customer_id
WHERE b.customer_id IS NULL
ORDER BY a.customer_id

# Question

Liste je Land die Anzahl der Kunden, die zwischen den Stichtagen 2026-03-31 und 2026-06-30 laut unserer Aktiv-Definition aktiv geworden sind (am späteren Stichtag aktiv, am früheren nicht).

# SQL

WITH active_asof AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    c.customer_id,
    c.country_code,
    DATE '2026-06-30' AS as_of_date
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT
    c.customer_id,
    c.country_code,
    DATE '2026-03-31' AS as_of_date
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-03-31', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-03-31'
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    country_code,
    MAX(IF(as_of_date = DATE '2026-06-30', 1, 0)) AS active_late,
    MAX(IF(as_of_date = DATE '2026-03-31', 1, 0)) AS active_early
  FROM active_asof
  GROUP BY customer_id, country_code
),
became_active AS (
  SELECT customer_id, country_code
  FROM flagged
  WHERE active_late = 1 AND active_early = 0
)

  country_code,
  COUNT(*) AS anzahl_kunden
FROM became_active
GROUP BY country_code
ORDER BY country_code;

# Question

Welche Kunden waren laut unserer Aktiv-Definition sowohl zum Stichtag 2026-01-31 als auch zum Stichtag 2026-04-30 aktiv? Gib für jeden dieser Kunden die zuletzt vor oder am späteren Stichtag aufgegebene, nicht stornierte Bestellung zurück (customer_id, order_id, order_date), sortiert nach customer_id.

# SQL

WITH active_jan AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
  FROM ecom_v1.customers AS c
  INNER JOIN ecom_v1.orders AS o
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-01-31', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-01-31'
),
active_apr AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
  FROM ecom_v1.customers AS c
  INNER JOIN ecom_v1.orders AS o
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-04-30', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-04-30'
),
both_active AS (
  SELECT customer_id FROM active_jan
  INTERSECT DISTINCT
  SELECT customer_id FROM active_apr
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    o.order_id,
    o.order_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.customer_id
      ORDER BY o.order_date DESC, o.order_id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM ecom_v1.orders AS o
  INNER JOIN both_active AS b
    ON b.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date <= DATE '2026-04-30'
)
SELECT customer_id, order_id, order_date
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY customer_id;

# Question

Wie viele aktive Kunden gab es je Kundensegment zum Stichtag 2025-09-30 bzw. 2025-12-31, wenn die Aktiv-Definition jeweils auf ein eigenes 90-Tage-Fenster bis einschließlich des jeweiligen Stichtags angewendet wird (nicht stornierte Bestellungen, keine gelöschten Konten)? Gib Segment sowie die beiden Aktiv-Zählungen aus.

# SQL

WITH asof AS (
  SELECT DATE '2025-09-30' AS asof_date, '2025-09-30' AS label
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE '2025-12-31', '2025-12-31'
),
aktive AS (
  SELECT
    a.label,
    c.segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS aktive_kunden
  FROM asof a
  INNER JOIN ecom_v1.customers c
    ON c.deleted_at IS NULL
  INNER JOIN ecom_v1.orders o
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
   AND o.order_status != 'cancelled'
   AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(a.asof_date, INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND a.asof_date
  GROUP BY a.label, c.segment
)
SELECT
  segment,
  MAX(IF(label = '2025-09-30', aktive_kunden, NULL)) AS aktive_kunden_2025_09_30,
  MAX(IF(label = '2025-12-31', aktive_kunden, NULL)) AS aktive_kunden_2025_12_31
FROM aktive
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY segment

# Question

Wie viele gehaltene, neu aktive und nicht mehr aktive Kunden gab es je Land zwischen dem 31.03.2026 und dem 30.06.2026, gemessen an unserer Aktiv-Definition (90-Tage-Fenster bis zum jeweiligen Stichtag, ohne Stornos, ohne gelöschte Konten)?

# SQL

WITH active_end AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.country_code
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-06-30'
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
),
active_start AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.country_code
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-03-31', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-03-31'
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
),
retained AS (
  SELECT customer_id, country_code FROM active_end
  INTERSECT DISTINCT
  SELECT customer_id, country_code FROM active_start
),
newly_active AS (
  SELECT customer_id, country_code FROM active_end
  EXCEPT DISTINCT
  SELECT customer_id, country_code FROM active_start
),
churned AS (
  SELECT customer_id, country_code FROM active_start
  EXCEPT DISTINCT
  SELECT customer_id, country_code FROM active_end
),
countries AS (
  SELECT country_code FROM active_end
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT country_code FROM active_start
)
SELECT
  co.country_code,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retained r WHERE r.country_code = co.country_code) AS gehaltene_kunden,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM newly_active n WHERE n.country_code = co.country_code) AS neu_aktive_kunden,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM churned ch WHERE ch.country_code = co.country_code) AS nicht_mehr_aktive_kunden
FROM countries co
ORDER BY co.country_code

# Question

Welche aktiven Kunden hatten ihre erste qualifizierende Bestellung im aktuellen 90-Tage-Fenster erst im Juni 2026? Gib customer_id, customer_number und das Datum dieser ersten Bestellung zurück.

# SQL

WITH window_orders AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_number,
    o.order_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_date, o.order_id) AS rn
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-06-30', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-06-30'
)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  customer_number,
  order_date AS first_qualifying_order_date
FROM window_orders
WHERE rn = 1
  AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY customer_id

# Question

Wie hoch ist die Bindungsquote der Aktiven Kunden vom Stichtag 2025-12-31 zu denen, die am 2026-03-31 weiterhin Aktive Kunden sind? Ein Aktiver Kunde hat mindestens eine nicht stornierte Bestellung in den 90 Tagen bis einschließlich des jeweiligen Stichtags und gelöschte Konten sind an jedem Stichtag auszuschließen. Gib die Quote als Anteil der zum ersten Stichtag Aktiven Kunden aus, die auch zum zweiten Stichtag aktiv sind.

# SQL

WITH active_2025_12_31 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2025-12-31', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2025-12-31'
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
),
active_2026_03_31 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE '2026-03-31', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND DATE '2026-03-31'
    AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT a.customer_id,
         CASE WHEN b.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retained_flag
  FROM active_2025_12_31 a
  LEFT JOIN active_2026_03_31 b
    ON a.customer_id = b.customer_id
)
SELECT SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(retained_flag), COUNT(*)) AS retention_rate
FROM cohort

# Question

Wie unterscheidet sich der Deckungsbeitrag nach Abzug von Retouren je Hauptkategorie zwischen dem ersten Halbjahr 2025 und dem ersten Halbjahr 2026? Bitte die Kategoriehierarchie auflösen, Retourenerstattungen je Bestellposition voraggregieren und für jede Hauptkategorie den Deckungsbeitrag beider Halbjahre sowie die absolute Veränderung ausweisen, sortiert nach Hauptkategorie.

# SQL

WITH refunds_per_item AS (
  SELECT
    r.order_item_id,
    SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_amount
  FROM ecom_v1.returns r
  GROUP BY r.order_item_id
),
line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_date,
    CASE
      WHEN c.parent_category_id IS NULL THEN c.category_id
      ELSE c.parent_category_id
    END AS main_category_id,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - COALESCE(rf.refund_amount, 0)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  LEFT JOIN refunds_per_item rf ON rf.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
    )
),
period_agg AS (
  SELECT
    main_category_id,
    CASE
      WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-06-30' THEN 'H1_2025'
      ELSE 'H1_2026'
    END AS period,
    SUM(contribution_margin) AS contribution_margin
  FROM line_cm
  GROUP BY main_category_id, period
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    main_category_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2025' THEN contribution_margin ELSE 0 END) AS cm_h1_2025,
    SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'H1_2026' THEN contribution_margin ELSE 0 END) AS cm_h1_2026
  FROM period_agg
  GROUP BY main_category_id
)
SELECT
  mc.category_name AS hauptkategorie,
  p.cm_h1_2025,
  p.cm_h1_2026,
  p.cm_h1_2026 - p.cm_h1_2025 AS delta_cm
FROM pivoted p
JOIN ecom_v1.categories mc ON mc.category_id = p.main_category_id
ORDER BY mc.category_name;

Welche Hauptkategorien hatten 2025 einen niedrigeren Deckungsbeitrag nach Abzug von Retouren als 2024? Gib je Hauptkategorie den Namen sowie den Deckungsbeitrag 2024 und 2025 aus.

# SQL

WITH line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_date,
    COALESCE(parent.category_id, cat.category_id) AS main_category_id,
    COALESCE(parent.category_name, cat.category_name) AS main_category_name,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories parent ON parent.category_id = cat.parent_category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
    FROM ecom_v1.returns
    GROUP BY order_item_id
  ) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
),
yearly AS (
  SELECT
    main_category_id,
    main_category_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS yr,
    SUM(contribution_margin) AS cm
  FROM line_cm
  GROUP BY main_category_id, main_category_name, yr
),
compared AS (
  SELECT
    main_category_id,
    main_category_name,
    yr,
    cm,
    LAG(cm) OVER (PARTITION BY main_category_id ORDER BY yr) AS cm_prev
  FROM yearly
)
SELECT
  main_category_name,
  cm_prev AS deckungsbeitrag_2024,
  cm AS deckungsbeitrag_2025
FROM compared
WHERE yr = 2025
  AND cm_prev IS NOT NULL
  AND cm < cm_prev
ORDER BY main_category_name;

# Question

Wie hoch ist der Deckungsbeitrag nach Abzug von Retouren je Hauptkategorie im ersten und zweiten Quartal 2026, und wie groß ist die absolute Veränderung von Q1 auf Q2?

# SQL

WITH line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(parent.category_name, cat.category_name) AS hauptkategorie,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31' THEN 'Q1'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' THEN 'Q2'
    END AS quartal,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories parent ON parent.category_id = cat.parent_category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
    FROM ecom_v1.returns
    GROUP BY order_item_id
  ) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    hauptkategorie,
    quartal,
    SUM(deckungsbeitrag) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM line_cm
  GROUP BY hauptkategorie, quartal
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    hauptkategorie,
    SUM(CASE WHEN quartal = 'Q1' THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS db_q1,
    SUM(CASE WHEN quartal = 'Q2' THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS db_q2
  FROM agg
  GROUP BY hauptkategorie
)
SELECT
  hauptkategorie,
  db_q1,
  db_q2,
  db_q2 - db_q1 AS absolute_veraenderung
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY hauptkategorie;

Welche drei Hauptkategorien verzeichneten den größten Anstieg des Deckungsbeitrags nach Abzug von Retouren vom zweiten Halbjahr 2024 zum zweiten Halbjahr 2025? Bitte Hauptkategoriename, Deckungsbeitrag H2 2024, Deckungsbeitrag H2 2025 und die absolute Veränderung ausgeben.

# SQL

WITH refunds AS (
  SELECT
    r.order_item_id,
    SUM(r.refund_amount) AS refund_amount
  FROM ecom_v1.returns r
  GROUP BY r.order_item_id
),
line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(pc.category_id, cat.category_id) AS main_category_id,
    COALESCE(pc.category_name, cat.category_name) AS main_category_name,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31' THEN 'h2_2024'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' THEN 'h2_2025'
    END AS period,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - COALESCE(rf.refund_amount, 0)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories pc ON pc.category_id = cat.parent_category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  LEFT JOIN refunds rf ON rf.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE (o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
    ))
),
period_cm AS (
  SELECT
    main_category_id,
    main_category_name,
    period,
    SUM(contribution_margin) AS contribution_margin
  FROM line_cm
  GROUP BY main_category_id, main_category_name, period
),
compared AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(a.main_category_id, b.main_category_id) AS main_category_id,
    COALESCE(a.main_category_name, b.main_category_name) AS main_category_name,
    COALESCE(a.contribution_margin, 0) AS cm_h2_2024,
    COALESCE(b.contribution_margin, 0) AS cm_h2_2025,
    COALESCE(b.contribution_margin, 0) - COALESCE(a.contribution_margin, 0) AS cm_increase
  FROM period_cm a
  FULL OUTER JOIN period_cm b
    ON a.main_category_id = b.main_category_id
   AND a.period = 'h2_2024'
   AND b.period = 'h2_2025'
  WHERE COALESCE(a.period, 'h2_2024') = 'h2_2024'
    AND COALESCE(b.period, 'h2_2025') = 'h2_2025'

# Question

Wie hat sich der prozentuale Anteil jeder Hauptkategorie am gesamten Deckungsbeitrag nach Abzug von Retouren zwischen den Kalenderjahren 2024 und 2025 verändert? Gib je Hauptkategorie den Anteil 2024, den Anteil 2025 und die Differenz in Prozentpunkten aus, sortiert nach Hauptkategoriename.

# SQL

WITH line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS yr,
    CASE
      WHEN c.parent_category_id IS NULL THEN c.category_id
      ELSE c.parent_category_id
    END AS main_category_id,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - IFNULL(r.refund_amount, 0)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
    FROM ecom_v1.returns
    GROUP BY order_item_id
  ) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
),
cat_year AS (
  SELECT
    mc.category_name AS hauptkategorie,
    lc.yr,
    SUM(lc.contribution_margin) AS cm
  FROM line_cm lc
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories mc ON mc.category_id = lc.main_category_id
  GROUP BY mc.category_name, lc.yr
),
with_share AS (
  SELECT
    hauptkategorie,
    yr,
    cm,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(cm, SUM(cm) OVER (PARTITION BY yr)) * 100 AS share_pct
  FROM cat_year
)
SELECT
  y24.hauptkategorie,
  y24.share_pct AS anteil_2024_pct,
  y25.share_pct AS anteil_2025_pct,
  y25.share_pct - y24.share_pct AS differenz_pp
FROM with_share y24
JOIN with_share y25
  ON y24.hauptkategorie = y25.hauptkategorie
 AND y24.yr = 2024
 AND y25.yr = 2025
ORDER BY y24.hauptkategorie

# Question

Welche Hauptkategorien hatten im Kalenderjahr 2025 einen positiven Deckungsbeitrag vor Retouren, aber einen negativen Deckungsbeitrag nach Abzug der Retouren? Gib Hauptkategorie-ID, Name sowie beide Deckungsbeiträge aus, sortiert nach Name.

# SQL

WITH line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(pc.category_id, c.category_id) AS main_category_id,
    COALESCE(pc.category_name, c.category_name) AS main_category_name,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS cm_before_returns,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS cm_after_returns
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories pc ON pc.category_id = c.parent_category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
    FROM ecom_v1.returns
    GROUP BY order_item_id
  ) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    main_category_id,
    main_category_name,
    SUM(cm_before_returns) AS cm_before_returns,
    SUM(cm_after_returns) AS cm_after_returns,
    SUM(SUM(cm_before_returns)) OVER () AS total_cm_before_2025,
    SUM(SUM(cm_after_returns)) OVER () AS total_cm_after_2025
  FROM line_cm
  GROUP BY main_category_id, main_category_name
),
pos_before AS (
  SELECT main_category_id FROM agg WHERE cm_before_returns > 0
),
neg_after AS (
  SELECT main_category_id FROM agg WHERE cm_after_returns < 0
)
SELECT
  a.main_category_id,
  a.main_category_name,
  a.cm_before_returns,
  a.cm_after_returns
FROM agg a
WHERE a.main_category_id IN (
  SELECT main_category_id FROM pos_before
  INTERSECT DISTINCT
  SELECT main_category_id FROM neg_after
)
ORDER BY a.main_category_name, a.main_category_id

# Question

Wie hoch war 2025 je Hauptkategorie der Deckungsbeitrag nach Abzug von Retouren bei Partnerkanälen im Vergleich zu Nicht-Partner-Kanälen?

# SQL

WITH refunds AS (
  SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
  FROM ecom_v1.returns
  GROUP BY order_item_id
),
line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(parent.category_name, cat.category_name) AS hauptkategorie,
    ch.channel_type,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - IFNULL(r.refund_amount, 0)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories parent ON parent.category_id = cat.parent_category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    hauptkategorie,
    SUM(CASE WHEN channel_type = 'partner' THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS db_partner,
    SUM(CASE WHEN channel_type != 'partner' THEN deckungsbeitrag ELSE 0 END) AS db_nicht_partner
  FROM line_cm
  GROUP BY hauptkategorie
)
SELECT
  hauptkategorie,
  db_partner,
  db_nicht_partner,
  db_partner - db_nicht_partner AS db_differenz_partner_minus_nicht_partner,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY db_partner - db_nicht_partner DESC, hauptkategorie) AS rang_differenz
FROM agg
ORDER BY hauptkategorie;

# Question

Welche Hauptkategorien hatten von 2024 auf 2025 einen gestiegenen retourenbereinigten Deckungsbeitrag, obwohl der retourenbereinigte Netto-Umsatz zurückging? Gib die Hauptkategorienamen aus.

# SQL

WITH line_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(parent.category_id, cat.category_id) AS main_category_id,
    COALESCE(parent.category_name, cat.category_name) AS main_category_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS yr,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0) AS net_rev_adj,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS cm_adj
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories parent ON parent.category_id = cat.parent_category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
    FROM ecom_v1.returns
    GROUP BY order_item_id
  ) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
),
yearly AS (
  SELECT
    main_category_id,
    main_category_name,
    yr,
    SUM(net_rev_adj) AS net_rev,
    SUM(cm_adj) AS cm
  FROM line_metrics
  GROUP BY main_category_id, main_category_name, yr
),
compared AS (
  SELECT
    main_category_id,
    main_category_name,
    yr,
    net_rev,
    cm,
    LAG(net_rev) OVER (PARTITION BY main_category_id ORDER BY yr) AS prev_net_rev,
    LAG(cm) OVER (PARTITION BY main_category_id ORDER BY yr) AS prev_cm
  FROM yearly
)
SELECT main_category_name
FROM compared
WHERE yr = 2025
  AND prev_net_rev IS NOT NULL
  AND net_rev < prev_net_rev
  AND cm > prev_cm
ORDER BY main_category_name;

# Question

Vergleiche den retourenbereinigten Deckungsbeitrag je Hauptkategorie zwischen den letzten 90 Tagen bis einschließlich 2025-12-31 und dem unmittelbar davor liegenden 90-Tage-Fenster. Gib je Hauptkategorie den Deckungsbeitrag der aktuellen Periode, den der Vorperiode sowie die absolute Differenz (aktuell minus Vorperiode) aus, sortiert nach Hauptkategoriename.

# SQL

WITH windows AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_SUB(DATE '2025-12-31', INTERVAL 90 DAY) AS curr_start,
    DATE '2025-12-31' AS curr_end,
    DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(DATE '2025-12-31', INTERVAL 90 DAY), INTERVAL 91 DAY) AS prev_start,
    DATE_SUB(DATE_SUB(DATE '2025-12-31', INTERVAL 90 DAY), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS prev_end
),
line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN cat.parent_category_id IS NULL THEN cat.category_name
      ELSE parent.category_name
    END AS hauptkategorie,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN w.curr_start AND w.curr_end THEN 'aktuell'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN w.prev_start AND w.prev_end THEN 'vorperiode'
    END AS periode,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - IFNULL(r.refund_amount, 0)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS db
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.categories cat ON cat.category_id = p.category_id
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.categories parent ON parent.category_id = cat.parent_category_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  CROSS JOIN windows w
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT order_item_id, SUM(refund_amount) AS refund_amount
    FROM ecom_v1.returns
    GROUP BY order_item_id
  ) r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN w.curr_start AND w.curr_end
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN w.prev_start AND w.prev_end
    )
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    hauptkategorie,
    periode,
    SUM(db) AS db
  FROM line_cm
  GROUP BY hauptkategorie, periode
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    hauptkategorie,
    SUM(CASE WHEN periode = 'aktuell' THEN db ELSE 0 END) AS db_aktuell,
    SUM(CASE WHEN periode = 'vorperiode' THEN db ELSE 0 END) AS db_vorperiode
  FROM agg
  GROUP BY hauptkategorie
)
SELECT
  hauptkategorie,
  db_aktuell,
  db_vorperiode,
  db_aktuell - db_vorperiode AS db_differenz
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY hauptkategorie

# Question

Welche Kundensegmente haben über alle nicht stornierten Bestellungen hinweg einen negativen Deckungsbeitrag? Bitte zuerst den vorzeichenbehafteten Deckungsbeitrag je Segment aggregieren und anschließend nur Segmente mit einem Gesamtwert unter null ausgeben.

# SQL

WITH line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    c.segment,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
),
seg AS (
  SELECT
    segment,
    SUM(contribution_margin) OVER (PARTITION BY segment) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM line_cm
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  segment,
  deckungsbeitrag
FROM seg
WHERE deckungsbeitrag < 0
ORDER BY segment

WITH line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    oi.order_item_id,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'

# Question

Welche Produkte haben über alle nicht stornierten Bestellungen hinweg einen negativen aggregierten Deckungsbeitrag und kamen in mindestens fünf verschiedenen Bestellungen vor? Gib product_id, sku, product_name, den aggregierten Deckungsbeitrag und die Anzahl distinkter Bestellungen aus, sortiert nach Deckungsbeitrag aufsteigend und product_id.

# SQL

WITH line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    oi.product_id,
    o.order_id,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    SUM(contribution_margin) AS total_cm,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS n_orders
  FROM line_cm
  GROUP BY product_id
),
neg_cm AS (
  SELECT product_id FROM agg WHERE total_cm < 0
),
enough_orders AS (
  SELECT product_id FROM agg WHERE n_orders >= 5
),
qualified AS (
  SELECT product_id FROM neg_cm
  INTERSECT DISTINCT
  SELECT product_id FROM enough_orders
)
SELECT
  p.product_id,
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  a.total_cm AS deckungsbeitrag,
  a.n_orders,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.total_cm ASC, p.product_id) AS rang
FROM qualified q
JOIN agg a ON a.product_id = q.product_id
JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = q.product_id
ORDER BY a.total_cm ASC, p.product_id

# Question

Welche Partnerkanäle hatten 2025 einen negativen gesamten Deckungsbeitrag nach Provision? Gib Kanal-ID, Kanalname und den gesamten Deckungsbeitrag aus.

# SQL

WITH line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    ch.channel_id,
    ch.channel_name,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
    AND ch.channel_type = 'partner'
),
channel_cm AS (
  SELECT
    channel_id,
    channel_name,
    SUM(contribution_margin) AS total_cm,
    SUM(SUM(contribution_margin)) OVER () AS partner_cm_sum
  FROM line_cm
  GROUP BY channel_id, channel_name
)

FROM channel_cm
WHERE total_cm < 0
ORDER BY channel_name, channel_id
