WITH line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    o.payment_method,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate

  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id

    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'

    SUM(contribution_margin) AS deckungsbeitrag,

  GROUP BY payment_method
)

# Question

Welche fünf Kunden haben den niedrigsten aggregierten Deckungsbeitrag über alle nicht stornierten Bestellungen, inklusive negativer und positiver Summen? Nutze einen deterministischen Top-5-Cutoff bei Gleichstand.

# SQL

WITH line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
             THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
             ELSE 0 END AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_number,
    SUM(lc.contribution_margin) AS deckungsbeitrag
  FROM ecom_v1.customers c
  JOIN line_cm lc ON lc.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_number
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    customer_number,
    deckungsbeitrag,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY deckungsbeitrag ASC, customer_id ASC) AS rn
  FROM agg
)

FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5
ORDER BY deckungsbeitrag ASC, customer_id ASC

# Question

Wie viele Kunden je Segment haben einen negativen Deckungsbeitrag, wenn man den Deckungsbeitrag zuerst je Kunde aggregiert und erst danach nach Segment zählt?

# SQL

WITH line_cm AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate)
      - oi.quantity * p.purchase_price
      - CASE
          WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner'
            THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross * ch.commission_rate
          ELSE 0
        END AS contribution_margin
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items AS oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders AS o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products AS p
    ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels AS ch
    ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
),
cust_cm AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    SUM(contribution_margin) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) AS cust_cm
  FROM line_cm
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY customer_id) = 1
)

  c.segment,
  COUNT(*) AS anzahl_kunden
FROM cust_cm AS cm
JOIN ecom_v1.customers AS c
  ON c.customer_id = cm.customer_id
WHERE cm.cust_cm < 0
GROUP BY c.segment
ORDER BY c.segment

# Question

Welche Produkte hatten im ersten Halbjahr 2026 (Bestelldatum 2026-01-01 bis 2026-06-30) mindestens 100 verkaufte Einheiten aus nicht stornierten Bestellungen und eine Retourenquote über 10 Prozent? Die Retourenquote ist das Verhältnis der retournierten Stückzahl zur verkauften Stückzahl (Teilretouren zählen anteilig). Gib product_id, product_name, sold_units, quantity_returned, return_rate und den Rang nach absteigender Retourenquote (bei Gleichstand nach product_id) aus.

# SQL

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS sold_units
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
),
ret AS (
  SELECT
    oi.product_id,
    SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS quantity_returned
  FROM ecom_v1.returns r
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY oi.product_id
),
high_volume AS (
  SELECT product_id FROM sold WHERE sold_units >= 100
),
high_return AS (
  SELECT
    s.product_id
  FROM sold s
  LEFT JOIN ret r ON r.product_id = s.product_id
  WHERE SAFE_DIVIDE(IFNULL(r.quantity_returned, 0), s.sold_units) > 0.10
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT product_id FROM high_volume
  INTERSECT DISTINCT
  SELECT product_id FROM high_return
)
SELECT
  s.product_id,
  s.product_name,
  s.sold_units,
  IFNULL(r.quantity_returned, 0) AS quantity_returned,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(IFNULL(r.quantity_returned, 0), s.sold_units) AS return_rate,
  RANK() OVER (
    ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(IFNULL(r.quantity_returned, 0), s.sold_units) DESC, s.product_id
  ) AS return_rate_rank
FROM eligible e
JOIN sold s ON s.product_id = e.product_id
LEFT JOIN ret r ON r.product_id = e.product_id
ORDER BY return_rate DESC, s.product_id;

Welche fünf Produkte hatten 2024 die höchste Retourenquote? Die Retourenquote ist die zurückgegebene Stückzahl geteilt durch die verkaufte Stückzahl aus nicht stornierten Bestellungen (Teilretouren zählen anteilig); Produkte ohne verkaufte Menge sind auszuschließen. Gib product_id, product_name und Retourenquote zurück.

# SQL

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT
    oi.product_id,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty_sold
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items AS oi
  INNER JOIN ecom_v1.orders AS o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
  GROUP BY oi.product_id
),
ret AS (
  SELECT
    oi.product_id,
    SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS qty_returned
  FROM ecom_v1.returns AS r
  INNER JOIN ecom_v1.order_items AS oi
    ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
  INNER JOIN ecom_v1.orders AS o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
  GROUP BY oi.product_id
),
rates AS (
  SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(ret.qty_returned, 0), sold.qty_sold) AS retourenquote,
    RANK() OVER (
      ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(ret.qty_returned, 0), sold.qty_sold) DESC,
               p.product_id

  INNER JOIN ecom_v1.products AS p
    ON p.product_id = sold.product_id
  LEFT JOIN ret
    ON ret.product_id = sold.product_id
  WHERE sold.qty_sold > 0
)
SELECT
  product_id,
  product_name,
  retourenquote
FROM rates
WHERE rk <= 5
ORDER BY retourenquote DESC, product_id

# Question

Zähle je Hauptkategorie die nicht abgesetzten Artikel, deren Retourenquote im Kalenderjahr 2025 über 20 Prozent lag.

# SQL

WITH sold_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    oi.product_id,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty_sold
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items AS oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders AS o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY oi.product_id
),
ret_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    oi.product_id,
    SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS qty_ret
  FROM ecom_v1.returns AS r
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items AS oi
    ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders AS o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY oi.product_id
),
rates AS (
  SELECT
    s.product_id,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(r.qty_ret, 0), s.qty_sold) AS return_rate,
    SUM(s.qty_sold) OVER (PARTITION BY s.product_id) AS qty_sold_w
  FROM sold_2025 AS s
  LEFT JOIN ret_2025 AS r
    ON r.product_id = s.product_id
),
high_rr AS (
  SELECT product_id
  FROM rates
  WHERE return_rate > 0.20
    AND qty_sold_w > 0
),
active_high AS (
  SELECT product_id
  FROM ecom_v1.products
  WHERE discontinued_on IS NULL
  INTERSECT DISTINCT
  SELECT product_id
  FROM high_rr
)
SELECT
  mc.category_name AS hauptkategorie,
  COUNT(*) AS anzahl_produkte
FROM active_high AS ah
JOIN ecom_v1.products AS p
  ON p.product_id = ah.product_id
JOIN ecom_v1.categories AS c
  ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN ecom_v1.categories AS mc
  ON mc.category_id = COALESCE(c.parent_category_id, c.category_id)
GROUP BY mc.category_id, mc.category_name
ORDER BY mc.category_name, mc.category_id

# Question

Welche Produkte hatten 2025 eine höhere Retourenquote als 2024 und lagen 2025 über 15 Prozent? Gib product_id, product_name, Retourenquote 2024 und Retourenquote 2025 aus, sortiert nach product_id. Retourenquote ist die zurückgegebene Stückzahl geteilt durch die verkaufte Stückzahl nicht stornierter Bestellungen (Teilretouren voraggregiert je order_item_id).

# SQL

WITH ret AS (
  SELECT
    order_item_id,
    SUM(quantity_returned) AS qty_returned
  FROM ecom_v1.returns
  GROUP BY order_item_id
),
yearly AS (
  SELECT
    oi.product_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS yr,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty_sold,
    SUM(IFNULL(r.qty_returned, 0)) AS qty_returned
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  LEFT JOIN ret r
    ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY oi.product_id, yr
),
rates AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    yr,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(qty_returned, qty_sold) AS return_rate,
    LAG(SAFE_DIVIDE(qty_returned, qty_sold)) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY yr) AS prev_return_rate
  FROM yearly
)
SELECT
  p.product_id,
  p.product_name,
  r.prev_return_rate AS return_rate_2024,
  r.return_rate AS return_rate_2025
FROM rates r
JOIN ecom_v1.products p
  ON p.product_id = r.product_id
WHERE r.yr = 2025
  AND r.prev_return_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND r.return_rate > r.prev_return_rate
  AND r.return_rate > 0.15
ORDER BY p.product_id

# Question

Welche Produkte hatten in irgendeinem Kalendermonat des Jahres 2025 eine höhere retournierte Stückzahl als verkaufte Stückzahl? Gib jeweils Produkt und den betroffenen Monat aus. Retourenmengen dürfen nur mitzählen, wenn die zugehörige Bestellung fachlich nicht storniert ist; vergleiche die Retouren nach Monat des Rückgabedatums mit den Verkäufen nach Monat des Bestelldatums.

# SQL

WITH ret_by_item_month AS (
  SELECT
    r.order_item_id,
    DATE_TRUNC(r.return_date, MONTH) AS m,
    SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS qty_returned
  FROM ecom_v1.returns AS r
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
facts AS (
  SELECT
    oi.product_id,
    DATE_TRUNC(o.order_date, MONTH) AS m,
    oi.quantity AS sold_qty,
    0 AS returned_qty
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items AS oi
  INNER JOIN ecom_v1.orders AS o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    oi.product_id,
    r.m,
    0 AS sold_qty,
    r.qty_returned AS returned_qty
  FROM ret_by_item_month AS r
  INNER JOIN ecom_v1.order_items AS oi
    ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
  INNER JOIN ecom_v1.orders AS o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND r.m BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    m,
    SUM(sold_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, m) AS sold_qty,
    SUM(returned_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, m) AS returned_qty
  FROM facts
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  product_id,
  FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', m) AS affected_month
FROM monthly
WHERE returned_qty > sold_qty
ORDER BY product_id, affected_month

# Question

Für jedes Produkt: Wie unterscheiden sich die Retourenquoten 2025 zwischen Partnerkanälen und allen Nicht-Partner-Kanälen zusammen (Nicht-Partner zuerst aggregieren, nicht die höchste Einzelkanalquote)? Gib nur Produkte aus, bei denen die Differenz mehr als zehn Prozentpunkte beträgt.

# SQL

WITH returns_by_item AS (
  SELECT
    r.order_item_id,
    SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS quantity_returned
  FROM ecom_v1.returns r
  GROUP BY r.order_item_id
),
sales_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    oi.product_id,
    CASE WHEN ch.channel_type = 'partner' THEN 'partner' ELSE 'non_partner' END AS channel_group,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty_sold,
    SUM(COALESCE(ri.quantity_returned, 0)) AS qty_returned
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels ch
    ON ch.channel_id = o.channel_id
  LEFT JOIN returns_by_item ri
    ON ri.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY oi.product_id, channel_group
),
rates AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    MAX(IF(channel_group = 'partner', SAFE_DIVIDE(qty_returned, qty_sold), NULL)) AS partner_return_rate,
    MAX(IF(channel_group = 'non_partner', SAFE_DIVIDE(qty_returned, qty_sold), NULL)) AS non_partner_return_rate
  FROM sales_2025
  GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT
  r.product_id,
  p.product_name,
  r.partner_return_rate,
  r.non_partner_return_rate,
  r.partner_return_rate - r.non_partner_return_rate AS return_rate_diff_pp
FROM rates r
JOIN ecom_v1.products p
  ON p.product_id = r.product_id
WHERE ABS(r.partner_return_rate - r.non_partner_return_rate) > 0.10
ORDER BY r.product_id;

# Question

Welche nicht ausgelisteten Produkte hatten im Kalenderjahr 2025 eine höhere Retourenquote als der Durchschnitt ihrer Kategorie? Gib product_id, product_name, category_id, Retourenquote und den kategoriebezogenen Durchschnitt aus, sortiert nach category_id und product_id.

# SQL

WITH ret AS (
  SELECT
    r.order_item_id,
    SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS quantity_returned
  FROM ecom_v1.returns r
  GROUP BY r.order_item_id
),
line AS (
  SELECT
    oi.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    p.category_id,
    oi.quantity,
    COALESCE(ret.quantity_returned, 0) AS quantity_returned
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.products p
    ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  LEFT JOIN ret
    ON ret.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
    AND p.discontinued_on IS NULL
),
prod AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    product_name,
    category_id,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(quantity_returned), SUM(quantity)) AS return_rate
  FROM line
  GROUP BY product_id, product_name, category_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    product_id,
    product_name,
    category_id,
    return_rate,
    AVG(return_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY category_id) AS category_avg_return_rate
  FROM prod
)
SELECT
  product_id,
  product_name,
  category_id,
  return_rate,
  category_avg_return_rate
FROM ranked
WHERE return_rate > category_avg_return_rate
ORDER BY category_id, product_id;

# Question

Welche Produkte hatten im Kalenderjahr 2024 keine einzige Retoure (return_date), weisen aber im Kalenderjahr 2025 eine Retourenquote von über 10 Prozent auf? Die Retourenquote 2025 ist hausüblich die Summe quantity_returned mit return_date in 2025 geteilt durch die in 2025 über nicht stornierte Bestellungen verkaufte Menge (order_date, order_status ungleich cancelled). Gib product_id, sku, product_name und die Retourenquote 2025 aus, sortiert nach product_id.

# SQL

WITH sold_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    oi.product_id,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty_sold
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items AS oi
  INNER JOIN ecom_v1.orders AS o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY oi.product_id
),
ret_by_year AS (
  SELECT
    oi.product_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.return_date) AS return_year,
    SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS qty_returned
  FROM ecom_v1.returns AS r
  INNER JOIN ecom_v1.order_items AS oi
    ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
  INNER JOIN ecom_v1.orders AS o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY oi.product_id, return_year
),
rates AS (
  SELECT
    s.product_id,
    s.qty_sold,
    COALESCE(r25.qty_returned, 0) AS qty_returned_2025,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(COALESCE(r25.qty_returned, 0), s.qty_sold) AS return_rate_2025,
    SUM(COALESCE(r24.qty_returned, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.product_id) AS qty_returned_2024
  FROM sold_2025 AS s
  LEFT JOIN ret_by_year AS r25
    ON r25.product_id = s.product_id AND r25.return_year = 2025
  LEFT JOIN ret_by_year AS r24
    ON r24.product_id = s.product_id AND r24.return_year = 2024
)
SELECT
  p.product_id,
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  r.return_rate_2025
FROM rates AS r
INNER JOIN ecom_v1.products AS p
  ON p.product_id = r.product_id
WHERE r.return_rate_2025 > 0.10
  AND r.product_id IN (
    SELECT product_id FROM sold_2025
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT product_id FROM ret_by_year WHERE return_year = 2024 AND qty_returned > 0
  )
  AND r.qty_returned_2024 = 0
ORDER BY p.product_id

# Question

Welche Artikel hatten im ersten Quartal 2026 eine Retourenquote über 20 Prozent? Die Retourenquote ist hausintern die Summe der retournierten Stückzahlen geteilt durch die verkaufte Stückzahl nicht stornierter Bestellungen (Bestelldatum), und die retournierten Mengen müssen voraggregiert werden, damit die Verkaufsmengen nicht durch Mehrfachretouren aufgebläht werden. Gib Produkt-ID, Artikelname, verkaufte Menge, retournierte Menge und Retourenquote aus, sortiert nach Quote absteigend und Produkt-ID.

# SQL

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT
    oi.product_id,
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty_sold
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items AS oi
  INNER JOIN ecom_v1.orders AS o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31'
  GROUP BY oi.product_id
),
returned AS (
  SELECT
    oi.product_id,
    SUM(r.quantity_returned) AS qty_returned
  FROM ecom_v1.returns AS r
  INNER JOIN ecom_v1.order_items AS oi
    ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
  INNER JOIN ecom_v1.orders AS o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-03-31'
  GROUP BY oi.product_id
)
SELECT
  p.product_id,
  p.product_name,
  s.qty_sold,
  COALESCE(ret.qty_returned, 0) AS qty_returned,
  COALESCE(ret.qty_returned, 0) / s.qty_sold AS retourenquote
FROM sold AS s
INNER JOIN ecom_v1.products AS p
  ON p.product_id = s.product_id
LEFT JOIN returned AS ret
  ON ret.product_id = s.product_id
WHERE s.qty_sold > 0
  AND COALESCE(ret.qty_returned, 0) / s.qty_sold > 0.20
ORDER BY retourenquote DESC, p.product_id;

# Question

Wie viele Wiederkäufer gab es im Kalenderjahr 2024 und wie viele im Kalenderjahr 2025, wenn der Wiederkäufer-Status jeweils unabhängig nur innerhalb des betreffenden Jahres bestimmt wird?

# SQL

WITH non_cancelled AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS bestelljahr,
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', order_date) AS kalendermonat
  FROM ecom_v1.orders
  WHERE order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) IN (2024, 2025)
),
monate AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, bestelljahr, kalendermonat
  FROM non_cancelled
),
mit_fenster AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    bestelljahr,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, bestelljahr) AS anzahl_monate
  FROM monate
),
wiederkaufer_2024 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
  FROM mit_fenster
  WHERE bestelljahr = 2024 AND anzahl_monate >= 2
),
wiederkaufer_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
  FROM mit_fenster
  WHERE bestelljahr = 2025 AND anzahl_monate >= 2
),
jaerlich AS (
  SELECT 2024 AS jahr, COUNT(*) AS anzahl_wiederkaufer FROM wiederkaufer_2024
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2025 AS jahr, COUNT(*) AS anzahl_wiederkaufer FROM wiederkaufer_2025
)
SELECT jahr, anzahl_wiederkaufer
FROM jaerlich
ORDER BY jahr

# Question

Wie viele Wiederkäufer gab es je Kundensegment im ersten Halbjahr 2025 und im ersten Halbjahr 2026, und wie groß ist die Differenz (H1 2026 minus H1 2025)? Ein Kunde gilt nur dann als Wiederkäufer einer Periode, wenn er in genau diesem Halbjahr in mindestens zwei verschiedenen Kalendermonaten nicht stornierte Bestellungen hat; die Qualifikation erfolgt also je Kunde und Periode, bevor nach Segment aggregiert wird.

# SQL

WITH periods AS (
  SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS period_start, DATE '2025-06-30' AS period_end, 'H1_2025' AS period_label
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE '2026-01-01', DATE '2026-06-30', 'H1_2026'
),
customer_period AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    p.period_label,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', o.order_date)) AS distinct_months
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  INNER JOIN periods p
    ON o.order_date BETWEEN p.period_start AND p.period_end
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id, p.period_label
),
repeaters AS (
  SELECT customer_id, period_label
  FROM customer_period
  WHERE distinct_months >= 2
),
by_segment AS (
  SELECT
    c.segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(r.period_label = 'H1_2025', r.customer_id, NULL)) AS wiederkaufer_h1_2025,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(r.period_label = 'H1_2026', r.customer_id, NULL)) AS wiederkaufer_h1_2026
  FROM repeaters r
  INNER JOIN ecom_v1.customers c
    ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.segment
)
SELECT
  segment,
  wiederkaufer_h1_2025,
  wiederkaufer_h1_2026,
  wiederkaufer_h1_2026 - wiederkaufer_h1_2025 AS differenz_h1_2026_minus_h1_2025
FROM by_segment
ORDER BY segment;

  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS yr,
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym,
    o.order_id
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) IN (2024, 2025)
),
repeat_by_year AS (
  SELECT customer_id, yr
  FROM year_orders
  GROUP BY customer_id, yr
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ym) >= 2
),
line_rev AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS yr,
    o.customer_id,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate) AS net_rev
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) IN (2024, 2025)
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    lr.yr,
    SUM(lr.net_rev) AS total_net,
    SUM(CASE WHEN r.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN lr.net_rev ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_net
  FROM line_rev lr
  LEFT JOIN repeat_by_year r
    ON r.customer_id = lr.customer_id AND r.yr = lr.yr
  GROUP BY lr.yr
)
SELECT
  yr AS jahr,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(repeat_net, total_net) AS anteil_netto_umsatz_wiederkaufer
FROM agg
ORDER BY jahr

# Question

Wie hoch war der Anteil des Netto-Umsatzes von Wiederkäufern am gesamten Netto-Umsatz in Q4 2024 bzw. Q4 2025, wenn der Wiederkäufer-Status jeweils unabhängig innerhalb des Quartals bestimmt wird (nicht stornierte Bestellungen in mindestens zwei verschiedenen Kalendermonaten desselben Quartals)? Gib je Quartal den Wiederkäufer-Netto-Umsatz, den Gesamt-Netto-Umsatz und den Anteil zurück.

# SQL

WITH q_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.order_date,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31' THEN '2024-Q4'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' THEN '2025-Q4'
    END AS quarter_label
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
    )
),
repeat_customers AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    quarter_label
  FROM q_orders
  GROUP BY customer_id, quarter_label
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', order_date)) >= 2
),
line_rev AS (
  SELECT
    qo.quarter_label,
    qo.customer_id,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate) AS net_rev
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN q_orders qo ON qo.order_id = oi.order_id
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    lr.quarter_label,
    SUM(lr.net_rev) AS total_net_revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rc.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN lr.net_rev ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_net_revenue
  FROM line_rev lr
  LEFT JOIN repeat_customers rc
    ON rc.customer_id = lr.customer_id
   AND rc.quarter_label = lr.quarter_label
  GROUP BY lr.quarter_label
)
SELECT
  quarter_label,
  repeat_net_revenue,
  total_net_revenue,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(repeat_net_revenue, total_net_revenue) AS repeat_net_revenue_share
FROM agg
ORDER BY quarter_label

# Question

Zeige für jedes Land die Anzahl der Wiederkäufer im Kalenderjahr 2024 und im Kalenderjahr 2025 sowie die absolute Veränderung (2025 minus 2024). Ein Wiederkäufer ist nach Hausdefinition ein Kunde mit nicht stornierten Bestellungen in mindestens zwei verschiedenen Kalendermonaten innerhalb des jeweiligen Jahres. Die Prüfung auf Wiederkäufer erfolgt kundenbezogen, nicht als HAVING auf Länderebene; Länder ohne Wiederkäufer sollen mit 0 erscheinen.

# SQL

WITH countries AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT country_code
  FROM ecom_v1.customers
),
customer_year_months AS (
  SELECT
    c.country_code,
    o.customer_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', o.order_date)) AS distinct_months
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.customers c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY c.country_code, o.customer_id, order_year
),
repeat_customers AS (
  SELECT
    country_code,
    customer_id,
    order_year
  FROM customer_year_months
  WHERE distinct_months >= 2
),
year_counts AS (
  SELECT
    co.country_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(rc.order_year = 2024, rc.customer_id, NULL)) AS wiederkaufer_2024,
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(rc.order_year = 2025, rc.customer_id, NULL)) AS wiederkaufer_2025
  FROM countries co
  LEFT JOIN repeat_customers rc
    ON rc.country_code = co.country_code
  GROUP BY co.country_code
)
SELECT
  country_code,
  wiederkaufer_2024,
  wiederkaufer_2025,
  wiederkaufer_2025 - wiederkaufer_2024 AS absolute_aenderung
FROM year_counts
ORDER BY country_code

# Question

Wie viele Wiederkäufer gab es je Vertriebskanal im zweiten Halbjahr 2024 und im zweiten Halbjahr 2025? Qualifiziere Wiederkäufer jeweils nur anhand der nicht stornierten Bestellungen innerhalb der jeweiligen Halbjahresperiode (mindestens zwei verschiedene Kalendermonate), und zähle sie erst danach je Kanal anhand der Kanalbestellungen derselben Periode. Gib Kanalname, beide Periodenzahlen, die Differenz 2025 minus 2024 sowie den Rang der Differenz aus.

# SQL

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    o.channel_id,
    o.order_date,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31' THEN 'H2_2024'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' THEN 'H2_2025'
    END AS period
  FROM ecom_v1.orders AS o
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
    )
),
repeat_customers AS (
  SELECT period, customer_id
  FROM base
  GROUP BY period, customer_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', order_date)) >= 2
),
period_h2_2024 AS (
  SELECT ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name, COUNT(DISTINCT b.customer_id) AS wiederkaufer_cnt
  FROM ecom_v1.channels AS ch
  LEFT JOIN base AS b
    ON b.channel_id = ch.channel_id AND b.period = 'H2_2024'
  INNER JOIN repeat_customers AS rc
    ON rc.customer_id = b.customer_id AND rc.period = 'H2_2024'
  GROUP BY ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name
),
period_h2_2025 AS (
  SELECT ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name, COUNT(DISTINCT b.customer_id) AS wiederkaufer_cnt
  FROM ecom_v1.channels AS ch
  LEFT JOIN base AS b
    ON b.channel_id = ch.channel_id AND b.period = 'H2_2025'
  INNER JOIN repeat_customers AS rc
    ON rc.customer_id = b.customer_id AND rc.period = 'H2_2025'
  GROUP BY ch.channel_id, ch.channel_name
),
combined AS (
  SELECT channel_id, channel_name, wiederkaufer_cnt, 'H2_2024' AS period FROM period_h2_2024
  UNION ALL
  SELECT channel_id, channel_name, wiederkaufer_cnt, 'H2_2025' AS period FROM period_h2_2025
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    channel_id,
    channel_name,
    MAX(IF(period = 'H2_2024', wiederkaufer_cnt, 0)) AS wiederkaufer_h2_2024,
    MAX(IF(period = 'H2_2025', wiederkaufer_cnt, 0)) AS wiederkaufer_h2_2025
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY channel_id, channel_name
)
SELECT
  channel_name,
  wiederkaufer_h2_2024,
  wiederkaufer_h2_2025,
  wiederkaufer_h2_2025 - wiederkaufer_h2_2024 AS delta_wiederkaufer,
  RANK() OVER (
    ORDER BY wiederkaufer_h2_2025 - wiederkaufer_h2_2024 DESC, channel_name
  ) AS rang_delta
FROM pivoted
ORDER BY channel_name

Wie viele Wiederkäufer gab es jeweils am Monatsende von Januar bis Juni 2026, wenn der Status für jeden Monat ausschließlich anhand der nicht stornierten Bestellhistorie bis einschließlich dieses Monatsendes bestimmt wird? Gib Kalendermonat und Anzahl aus.

# SQL

WITH months AS (
  SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS month_start, DATE '2026-01-31' AS month_end, '2026-01' AS kalendermonat
  UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2026-02-01', DATE '2026-02-28', '2026-02'
  UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2026-03-01', DATE '2026-03-31', '2026-03'
  UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2026-04-01', DATE '2026-04-30', '2026-04'
  UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2026-05-01', DATE '2026-05-31', '2026-05'
  UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2026-06-01', DATE '2026-06-30', '2026-06'
),
valid_orders AS (
  SELECT customer_id, order_date, FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', order_date) AS ym

month_status AS (

    m.month_end,
    vo.customer_id,

# Question

Wie hoch war der Anteil der Wiederkäufer unter allen Kunden mit mindestens einer nicht stornierten Bestellung im jeweiligen Kalenderjahr, und wie unterscheidet sich dieser Anteil zwischen 2024 und 2025?

# SQL

WITH yearly_orders AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS jahr,
    customer_id,
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', order_date) AS ym
  FROM ecom_v1.orders
  WHERE order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) IN (2024, 2025)
),
customer_year AS (
  SELECT
    jahr,
    customer_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ym) AS distinct_months
  FROM yearly_orders
  GROUP BY jahr, customer_id
),
year_stats AS (
  SELECT
    jahr,
    COUNT(*) AS kunden_mit_bestellung,
    COUNTIF(distinct_months >= 2) AS wiederkaufer
  FROM customer_year
  GROUP BY jahr
)
SELECT
  jahr,
  kunden_mit_bestellung,
  wiederkaufer,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(wiederkaufer, kunden_mit_bestellung) AS anteil_wiederkaufer
FROM year_stats
ORDER BY jahr

# Question

Vergleiche je Zahlungsmethode den Netto-Umsatz derjenigen Kunden, die innerhalb von 2024 als Wiederkäufer gelten, mit dem Netto-Umsatz derjenigen, die innerhalb von 2025 als Wiederkäufer gelten. Ein Kunde gilt in einem Kalenderjahr als Wiederkäufer, wenn er in diesem Jahr nicht stornierte Bestellungen in mindestens zwei verschiedenen Kalendermonaten hat; der Umsatz ist nur aus denselben nicht stornierten Bestellungen des jeweiligen Jahres zu rechnen.

# SQL

WITH orders_y AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.payment_method,
    o.order_date,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS yr,
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) IN (2024, 2025)
),
month_flags AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, yr, ym
  FROM orders_y
),
repeat_cust AS (
  SELECT customer_id, yr
  FROM month_flags
  GROUP BY customer_id, yr
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ym) >= 2
),
line_net AS (
  SELECT
    oy.yr,
    oy.payment_method,
    oy.customer_id,
    (oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) / (1 + oi.tax_rate) AS net_rev
  FROM orders_y oy
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON oi.order_id = oy.order_id
  JOIN repeat_cust rc
    ON rc.customer_id = oy.customer_id AND rc.yr = oy.yr
),
by_pm_year AS (
  SELECT
    payment_method,
    yr,
    SUM(net_rev) AS net_revenue
  FROM line_net
  GROUP BY payment_method, yr
),
wide AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(a.payment_method, b.payment_method) AS payment_method,
    a.net_revenue AS net_revenue_2024,
    b.net_revenue AS net_revenue_2025
  FROM (SELECT * FROM by_pm_year WHERE yr = 2024) a
  FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM by_pm_year WHERE yr = 2025) b
    ON a.payment_method = b.payment_method
)
SELECT
  payment_method,
  net_revenue_2024,
  net_revenue_2025,
  net_revenue_2025 - net_revenue_2024 AS delta_net_revenue,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY net_revenue_2025 - net_revenue_2024 DESC NULLS LAST, payment_method) AS delta_rank
FROM wide
ORDER BY delta_rank, payment_method

# Question

Wie hoch war der durchschnittliche Bestellwert der periodenspezifischen Wiederkäufer in 2024 im Vergleich zu 2025? Wiederkäuferstatus darf nur anhand der nicht stornierten Bestellungen innerhalb des jeweiligen Kalenderjahres bestimmt werden, nicht über die gesamte Kundenhistorie. Gib den AOV je Jahr sowie die Differenz 2025 minus 2024 aus.

# SQL

WITH orders_base AS (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS order_year,
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) AS order_value
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY o.order_id, o.customer_id, order_year, ym
),
with_months AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    order_year,
    order_value,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ym) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, order_year) AS distinct_months
  FROM orders_base
),
repeat_orders AS (
  SELECT order_year, order_id, order_value
  FROM with_months
  WHERE distinct_months >= 2
),
yearly AS (
  SELECT
    order_year,
    AVG(order_value) AS avg_order_value
  FROM repeat_orders
  GROUP BY order_year
)
SELECT
  2024 AS jahr,
  y24.avg_order_value AS aov_wiederkaufer,
  y25.avg_order_value - y24.avg_order_value AS aov_delta_2025_minus_2024
FROM yearly y24
CROSS JOIN yearly y25
WHERE y24.order_year = 2024
  AND y25.order_year = 2025
UNION ALL
SELECT
  2025 AS jahr,
  y25.avg_order_value AS aov_wiederkaufer,
  y25.avg_order_value - y24.avg_order_value AS aov_delta_2025_minus_2024
FROM yearly y24
CROSS JOIN yearly y25
WHERE y24.order_year = 2024
  AND y25.order_year = 2025
ORDER BY jahr

# Question

GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY bruttoumsatz DESC, p.product_id DESC
LIMIT 5;
